byChoice.en: This action follows the order and uses clinical tolerance criteria.
byChoice.zh: 该措施遵医嘱，并根据临床耐受标准。

byChoice.en: Blanket avoidance of oral intake delays nutrition and is not supported when the patient is improving and tolerating intake.
byChoice.zh: 患者改善并能耐受摄入时，一概避免口服会延误营养支持。

byChoice.en: A stepwise liquid-only progression is not mandatory when low-fat solid food is ordered and tolerated.
byChoice.zh: 已有低脂固体食物医嘱且能耐受时，不必强制只按流质阶梯进展。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a lab is still abnormal but the patient is clinically improving, ask whether the lab is a treatment target or just a trailing marker.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当化验仍异常但患者临床好转时，要判断该化验是治疗目标，还是滞后的指标。

glossary.defZh: 不经口摄入食物或液体。
减少脂肪摄入以降低胰腺刺激的饮食。
根据疼痛、呕吐、肠功能和患者感受判断是否能安全进食。

stem.en: At Stage 3, classify each trend or finding based on how it should guide the nurse's evaluation.
stem.zh: 第 3 阶段，根据每项趋势或发现对护理评估的意义进行分类。

rows.en: SpO2 94% on 2 L nasal cannula to 96% on room air
rows.zh: SpO2 从鼻导管 2 L 下 94% 改善为空气中 96%

rows.en: Urine output improves to 50 mL/hr
rows.zh: 尿量改善至 50 mL/hr

rows.en: WBC, bilirubin, calcium, and lactate improve after ERCP
rows.zh: ERCP 后 WBC、胆红素、钙和乳酸改善

rows.en: Lipase remains elevated at 980 U/L but is trending down
rows.zh: 脂肪酶仍为 980 U/L，但呈下降趋势

rows.en: Recurrent fever or worsening oxygenation after initial improvement
rows.zh: 初步改善后再次发热或氧合恶化

rows.en: Unable to tolerate oral nutrition after 72 hours
rows.zh: 72 小时后仍不能耐受口服营养

columns.en: Escalation/CT trigger if persistent or worsening
columns.zh: 若持续或恶化需升级/考虑 CT

columns.en: Not a management target by itself

correct.en: The patient is improving because pain, hemodynamics, oxygenation, urine output, bilirubin, WBC, calcium, and lactate are all moving in the right direction after ERCP. Lipase can remain elevated and should not be used alone to decide feeding or recovery. Recurrent fever, worsening oxygenation, organ dysfunction, persistent pain, or inability to tolerate nutrition after 72 hours would require escalation and possible contrast-enhanced CT at an appropriate time to evaluate complications such as necrosis.
correct.zh: ERCP 后疼痛、血流动力学、氧合、尿量、胆红素、WBC、钙和乳酸均向好转方向变化，说明患者正在改善。脂肪酶可持续升高，不能单独用于决定进食或恢复情况。再次发热、氧合恶化、器官功能障碍、疼痛持续或 72 小时后仍不能耐受营养，均需升级处理，并在合适时机考虑增强 CT 评估坏死等并发症。

byChoice.en: Improving pain and vital signs show reduced inflammation and better perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 疼痛和生命体征改善说明炎症减轻、灌注改善。

byChoice.en: Weaning to room air with better saturation supports respiratory improvement.
byChoice.zh: 能停氧且氧饱和度改善，支持呼吸状态好转。

byChoice.en: Improved urine output indicates better renal perfusion and resuscitation response.
byChoice.zh: 尿量改善提示肾灌注和补液反应改善。

byChoice.en: Improving inflammatory, biliary, calcium, and perfusion markers supports response to ERCP and supportive care.
byChoice.zh: 炎症、胆道、钙和灌注指标改善，支持对 ERCP 和支持治疗有反应。

byChoice.en: Lipase trend is not the main management target and should not override clinical improvement.
byChoice.zh: 脂肪酶趋势不是主要管理目标，不应凌驾于临床改善之上。

byChoice.en: Recurrent fever or worsening oxygenation suggests persistent infection, incomplete source control, or another complication.
byChoice.zh: 再次发热或氧合恶化提示感染持续、源控制不完全或其他并发症。

byChoice.en: Failure to tolerate nutrition after 72 hours suggests a complicated course and warrants reassessment/escalation.
byChoice.zh: 72 小时后仍不能耐受营养提示病程复杂，需要重新评估和升级处理。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes with trends across systems, not one enzyme. Ask whether the patient is perfusing, oxygenating, clearing obstruction, and tolerating nutrition.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估结果要看多个系统的趋势，而不是一个酶值。要问患者是否灌注改善、氧合改善、梗阻解除、能否耐受营养。

glossary.defZh: 胰腺组织坏死的严重胰腺炎并发症，通常需要在合适时间通过影像评估。
组织灌注不足或代谢应激时可升高的指标。
使用造影剂的 CT，可帮助评估坏死、感染或其他腹部并发症。

correct.en: This case requires recognizing biliary pancreatitis at admission, distinguishing etiology cues from severity markers, treating symptomatic true hypocalcemia, identifying Stage 2 deterioration as evolving cholangitis from an impacted CBD stone, and supporting source control with urgent ERCP while maintaining perfusion, oxygenation, analgesia, and glucose management. Improvement after ERCP is evaluated by trends in pain, vital signs, oxygenation, urine output, WBC, bilirubin, lactate, calcium, and oral intake tolerance rather than lipase normalization alone.
correct.zh: 本病例要求在入院时识别胆源性胰腺炎，区分病因线索和严重程度指标，处理有症状的真正低钙血症，识别第 2 阶段病情恶化是 CBD 结石嵌顿导致的进展性胆管炎，并在维持灌注、氧合、镇痛和血糖管理的同时协助紧急 ERCP 进行源控制。ERCP 后是否好转应根据疼痛、生命体征、氧合、尿量、WBC、胆红素、乳酸、钙和进食耐受性等趋势判断，而不是单靠脂肪酶正常化。

testTakingStrategy.en: In unfolding GI emergencies, first identify the cause, then track severity and complications by timeline. Source control matters when obstruction plus infection is present.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 展开式胃肠急症题中，先识别病因，再按时间线追踪严重程度和并发症。存在梗阻加感染时，源控制是关键。

glossary.defZh: 胆结石阻塞胆胰管区域导致的急性胰腺炎。
胆道梗阻合并感染，可迅速进展为败血症。
用于胆胰管诊断和治疗的内镜操作，可取出胆总管结石。
血钙或离子钙偏低，可导致麻木、抽搐、心律变化等。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Major thermal burn with inhalation injury requiring fluid resuscitation and airway management
title.zh: 重度热烧伤合并吸入性损伤，需要液体复苏和气道管理

summary.en: A 35-year-old man weighing approximately 80 kg is rescued from a smoke-filled bedroom after a residential house fire. The burn injury occurred at 0600, and he arrives in the emergency department at 0640 with facial burns, hoarseness, throat tightness, carbonaceous sputum, hypotension, tachycardia, and extensive anterior partial-thickness burns.
summary.zh: 一名约80 kg的35岁男性在住宅火灾后从充满烟雾的卧室中被救出。烧伤发生于0600，患者于0640到达急诊，表现为面部烧伤、声音嘶哑、咽喉紧缩感、咳出炭黑色痰、低血压、心动过速，以及广泛前侧部分皮层烧伤。

content.en: No significant past medical history, no known allergies, and no home medications. Found conscious but confused in a smoke-filled bedroom approximately 40 minutes before ED arrival. Estimated weight is 80 kg. Visible burns involve the face, anterior chest, abdomen, and both anterior arms. Eyebrows and nasal hairs are singed. Carbonaceous sputum is noted when he coughs. He reports throat tightness and difficulty swallowing and speaks in a hoarse, raspy voice.
content.zh: 无重要既往病史，无已知过敏史，无长期用药。到达急诊约40分钟前，患者在充满烟雾的卧室中被发现，意识清醒但意识混乱。估计体重80 kg。可见烧伤累及面部、前胸、腹部和双侧前臂。眉毛和鼻毛被烧焦，咳嗽时可见炭黑色痰。患者诉咽喉紧缩和吞咽困难，说话声音嘶哑粗哑。

content.en: Temperature 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), heart rate 125/min, blood pressure 90/60 mmHg, respiratory rate 28/min, SpO2 93% on room air. Face: diffuse erythema and edema with blistering; edematous lips; posterior pharynx erythematous and mildly edematous with soot deposits. Voice markedly hoarse with audible stridor on forced inspiration. Chest/abdomen and both anterior arms: mixed superficial-to-deep partial-thickness burns with moist pink-to-red wound beds, intact pinprick sensation, blistering, and weeping. Posterior trunk, posterior arms, legs, and perineum are unburned. Radial pulses are palpable but thready; capillary refill is 4 seconds in both hands. No circumferential burns are present.
content.zh: 体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，心率125次/分，血压90/60 mmHg，呼吸28次/分，室内空气下SpO2 93%。面部弥漫性红斑、水肿并有水疱；口唇水肿；后咽部发红、轻度水肿并有烟灰沉积。声音明显嘶哑，用力吸气时可闻及喘鸣。胸腹部和双侧前臂为混合浅至深部分皮层烧伤，创面湿润、粉红至红色，针刺痛觉存在，有水疱和渗液。后躯干、双上臂后侧、双腿和会阴未烧伤。桡动脉搏动可触及但细弱；双手毛细血管再充盈4秒。无环形烧伤。

content.en: CBC: WBC 14.2 ×10³/µL, hemoglobin 16.8 g/dL, hematocrit 52%, platelets 210 ×10³/µL. BMP: sodium 139 mEq/L, potassium 5.1 mEq/L, chloride 102 mEq/L, bicarbonate 20 mEq/L, BUN 18 mg/dL, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, glucose 168 mg/dL. ABG on room air: pH 7.32, PaCO2 32 mmHg, PaO2 68 mmHg, HCO3 20 mEq/L, lactate 4.2 mmol/L. Carboxyhemoglobin 18%. Urinalysis: dark amber, specific gravity 1.035, negative for blood and red blood cells.
content.zh: 血常规：白细胞14.2 ×10³/µL，血红蛋白16.8 g/dL，血细胞比容52%，血小板210 ×10³/µL。基础代谢：钠139 mEq/L，钾5.1 mEq/L，氯102 mEq/L，碳酸氢根20 mEq/L，BUN 18 mg/dL，肌酐1.0 mg/dL，血糖168 mg/dL。室内空气下动脉血气：pH 7.32，PaCO2 32 mmHg，PaO2 68 mmHg，HCO3 20 mEq/L，乳酸4.2 mmol/L。一氧化碳血红蛋白18%。尿液分析：深琥珀色，比重1.035，血和红细胞阴性。

content.en: The patient is placed on 100% oxygen by non-rebreather mask. Two 16-gauge peripheral IVs are established in the dorsal veins of both feet because the bilateral arm burns preclude upper-extremity access. Lactated Ringer's solution is initiated. A rapid Rule of Nines assessment documents burns to the entire face/anterior scalp, entire anterior trunk, and both anterior arms from shoulders to wrists; posterior trunk, posterior arms, legs, and perineum are unburned. The provider orders lactated Ringer's using the commonly taught Parkland estimate: 4 mL x weight in kg x %TBSA burned, half in the first 8 hours from the burn time of 0600 and the remainder over the next 16 hours. Urine output target is 0.5 to 1 mL/kg/hr, or 40 to 80 mL/hr. Over the next 30 minutes hoarseness worsens, the patient drools, inspiratory stridor becomes audible without a stethoscope, SpO2 is 94% on the non-rebreather, and facial/lip edema progresses. The provider orders emergent intubation for impending airway obstruction; intubation is successful at 0725. Urine output from 0640 to 0740 is 15 mL of dark amber urine.
content.zh: 患者使用非再呼吸面罩给予100%氧气。由于双臂烧伤不适合上肢静脉通路，在双足背静脉建立两条16号外周静脉通路，并开始输注乳酸林格液。按九分法快速评估：烧伤累及整个面部/前头皮、整个前躯干，以及双侧肩至腕的前臂；后躯干、双上臂后侧、双腿和会阴未烧伤。医嘱按常用Parkland估算给予乳酸林格液：4 mL x 体重kg x 烧伤%TBSA；自0600烧伤时间起，前8小时给一半，其余16小时给另一半。尿量目标为0.5至1 mL/kg/hr，即40至80 mL/hr。随后30分钟内，声音嘶哑加重，患者流涎，不用听诊器即可听到吸气性喘鸣，非再呼吸面罩下SpO2为94%，面部和口唇水肿加重。医嘱因即将发生气道阻塞而紧急气管插管；0725插管成功。0640至0740尿量为15 mL深琥珀色尿。

title.en: Fluid titration and formal burn assessment
title.zh: 液体滴定与正式烧伤评估

content.en: The patient is intubated and sedated. LR is titrated according to hourly urine output. At 0800, urine output is 25 mL/hr and the nurse increases the infusion rate per protocol. At 1000, urine output is 35 mL/hr and remains below target; urine is dark yellow. ABG: pH 7.35, PaCO2 36 mmHg, PaO2 210 mmHg on FiO2 1.0, lactate 3.0 mmol/L; COHb has decreased to 8%. At 1200, urine output is 45 mL/hr, urine is yellow, HR 110/min, BP 102/68 mmHg, potassium 4.6 mEq/L, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, hematocrit 46%, lactate 2.1 mmol/L. Burn surgery confirms 31.5% TBSA: anterior trunk 18%, bilateral anterior arms 9% total, and anterior head/face 4.5%. No circumferential burns or full-thickness burns are identified. At 1400, urine output is 50 mL/hr and the first half of the calculated 24-hour resuscitation volume should have been delivered.
content.zh: 患者已插管并镇静。乳酸林格液根据每小时尿量滴定。0800尿量25 mL/hr，护士按方案增加输液速度。1000尿量35 mL/hr，仍低于目标；尿液为深黄色。动脉血气：pH 7.35，PaCO2 36 mmHg，FiO2 1.0下PaO2 210 mmHg，乳酸3.0 mmol/L；COHb降至8%。1200尿量45 mL/hr，尿液为黄色，心率110次/分，血压102/68 mmHg，钾4.6 mEq/L，肌酐1.0 mg/dL，血细胞比容46%，乳酸2.1 mmol/L。烧伤外科确认TBSA为31.5%：前躯干18%，双侧前臂合计9%，前头/面部4.5%。未发现环形烧伤或全层烧伤。1400尿量50 mL/hr，按计算24小时复苏量的前一半应已输注完成。

content.en: At 1600, urine output is 55 mL/hr, HR 100/min, BP 112/72 mmHg, and the patient is hemodynamically improving. At 1800, urine output has been 120 mL/hr for two consecutive hours. New bilateral basilar crackles are present; the face and eyelids are markedly more edematous; extremities are also becoming edematous. Labs: sodium 134 mEq/L, potassium 4.2 mEq/L, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, hematocrit 38%, albumin 2.1 g/dL. At 2000, urine output remains 110 mL/hr, peak airway pressures rise from 22 to 30 cmH2O, abdominal girth has increased by 4 cm from 1400, and the previously unburned hands are tense with capillary refill of 5 seconds and weaker radial pulses. The burn team notes that delivered volume has exceeded the time-phased expected Parkland trajectory by about 20%. At 2200, after the infusion rate is reduced, urine output is 70 mL/hr, peak airway pressure is 28 cmH2O, abdominal girth is stable, capillary refill in the hands is 4 seconds, and bladder pressure is 18 mmHg.
content.zh: 1600尿量55 mL/hr，心率100次/分，血压112/72 mmHg，血流动力学正在改善。1800时，尿量已连续两小时为120 mL/hr。出现新的双侧肺底湿啰音；面部和眼睑水肿明显加重；四肢也开始水肿。实验室：钠134 mEq/L，钾4.2 mEq/L，肌酐0.9 mg/dL，血细胞比容38%，白蛋白2.1 g/dL。2000尿量仍为110 mL/hr，气道峰压从22升至30 cmH2O，腹围较1400增加4 cm，原本未烧伤的双手紧绷，毛细血管再充盈5秒，桡动脉搏动变弱。烧伤团队指出，已输注量比Parkland分时预期轨迹约高20%。2200在降低输液速度后，尿量为70 mL/hr，气道峰压28 cmH2O，腹围稳定，双手毛细血管再充盈4秒，膀胱压18 mmHg。

stem.en: Using the Rule of Nines, calculate the percent total body surface area burned. Include only the entire face/anterior scalp, entire anterior trunk, and both anterior arms from shoulders to wrists.
stem.zh: 使用九分法计算烧伤总体表面积百分比。仅包括整个面部/前头皮、整个前躯干，以及双侧肩至腕的前臂。

correct.en: The burned areas are the anterior head/face 4.5%, anterior trunk 18%, right anterior arm 4.5%, and left anterior arm 4.5%, for a total of 31.5% TBSA. The posterior trunk, posterior arms, legs, and perineum are unburned and do not contribute to the calculation.
correct.zh: 烧伤部位为前头/面部4.5%、前躯干18%、右臂前侧4.5%、左臂前侧4.5%，合计31.5% TBSA。后躯干、双臂后侧、双腿和会阴未烧伤，不计入计算。

byChoice.en: The blank requires adding only the burned anterior surfaces. Counting both entire arms as 9% each would overestimate TBSA.
byChoice.zh: 此空需要只加总烧伤的前侧表面。如果把每只整臂都按9%计算，会高估TBSA。

testTakingStrategy.en: On burn-size questions, first decide anterior versus posterior involvement before adding the Rule-of-Nines percentages.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到烧伤面积题，先判断受累的是前侧还是后侧，再加总九分法百分比。

glossary.defZh: 成人烧伤面积的快速估算方法，将身体区域按9%或其倍数划分。
烧伤面积占全身表面积的百分比。
胸部和腹部前侧，在成人九分法中为18%。

stem.en: Highlight the findings that support impending upper-airway obstruction requiring emergent intubation rather than continued observation on a non-rebreather mask.
stem.zh: 请标出支持即将发生上气道阻塞、需要紧急气管插管而不是继续使用非再呼吸面罩观察的发现。

segments.en: Found in a smoke-filled bedroom.
segments.zh: 在充满烟雾的卧室中被发现。

segments.en: Awake but anxious.
segments.zh: 清醒但焦虑。

segments.en: Hoarse, raspy voice that worsens over 30 minutes.
segments.zh: 嘶哑粗哑的声音在30分钟内加重。

segments.en: Reports throat tightness and difficulty swallowing.
segments.zh: 诉咽喉紧缩和吞咽困难。

segments.en: Carbonaceous sputum when coughing.
segments.zh: 咳嗽时有炭黑色痰。

segments.en: Posterior pharynx has soot deposits with erythema and edema.
segments.zh: 后咽部有烟灰沉积，并伴发红和水肿。

segments.en: Progressive facial and lip edema.
segments.zh: 面部和口唇水肿进行性加重。

segments.en: Inspiratory stridor audible without a stethoscope.
segments.zh: 不用听诊器即可听到吸气性喘鸣。

segments.en: SpO2 94% on a non-rebreather mask.
segments.zh: 非再呼吸面罩下SpO2为94%。

segments.en: Blood pressure 88/58 mmHg and heart rate 130/min.
segments.zh: 血压88/58 mmHg，心率130次/分。

correct.en: Enclosed-space smoke exposure plus worsening hoarseness, throat tightness/dysphagia, carbonaceous sputum, pharyngeal soot/edema, progressive facial/lip edema, and audible stridor indicate inhalation injury with impending upper-airway obstruction. SpO2 can remain deceptively acceptable, especially with carbon monoxide exposure and supplemental oxygen, while edema progresses.
correct.zh: 密闭空间烟雾暴露，加上声音嘶哑加重、咽喉紧缩/吞咽困难、炭黑色痰、咽部烟灰和水肿、面部/口唇水肿进行性加重以及可闻及喘鸣，提示吸入性损伤导致即将发生上气道阻塞。即使存在一氧化碳暴露并给予氧气，SpO2仍可能看似尚可，而气道水肿继续进展。

byChoice.en: Enclosed-space smoke exposure increases concern for inhalation injury.
byChoice.zh: 密闭空间烟雾暴露会增加对吸入性损伤的担忧。

byChoice.en: Anxiety alone does not establish impending airway obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 单纯焦虑不能证明即将发生气道阻塞。

byChoice.en: Progressive hoarseness is a high-risk cue for laryngeal or supraglottic edema.
byChoice.zh: 进行性声音嘶哑是喉部或声门上水肿的高危线索。

byChoice.en: Throat tightness and dysphagia suggest upper-airway swelling.
byChoice.zh: 咽喉紧缩和吞咽困难提示上气道肿胀。

byChoice.en: Carbonaceous sputum supports smoke inhalation and airway contamination.
byChoice.zh: 炭黑色痰支持烟雾吸入和气道污染。

byChoice.en: Soot and edema in the posterior pharynx indicate direct upper-airway involvement.
byChoice.zh: 后咽部烟灰和水肿提示上气道直接受累。

byChoice.en: Progressive facial and lip edema can make delayed intubation difficult or impossible.
byChoice.zh: 面部和口唇水肿进行性加重会使延迟插管变得困难甚至不可能。

byChoice.en: Audible inspiratory stridor is a late sign of upper-airway narrowing and requires urgent airway action.
byChoice.zh: 可闻及吸气性喘鸣是上气道狭窄的晚期表现，需要紧急处理气道。

byChoice.en: A near-normal SpO2 on oxygen does not rule out impending mechanical airway obstruction.
byChoice.zh: 吸氧时SpO2接近正常不能排除即将发生机械性气道阻塞。

byChoice.en: Hypotension and tachycardia support shock/resuscitation needs, but they are not the airway-obstruction cues.
byChoice.zh: 低血压和心动过速支持休克和复苏需求，但不是气道阻塞线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not let an acceptable SpO2 distract you from airway anatomy. Hoarseness, stridor, drooling, and progressive facial/oropharyngeal edema in a burn patient are airway cues.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要因为SpO2尚可而忽视气道解剖问题。烧伤患者出现声音嘶哑、喘鸣、流涎和面部/口咽水肿进展，都是气道线索。

glossary.defZh: 上气道狭窄时产生的高调呼吸音，常提示紧急气道问题。
含烟灰或碳颗粒的痰液，提示烟雾吸入。
可提供高浓度氧气的面罩，但不能解决机械性气道阻塞。

stem.en: The provider orders lactated Ringer's using the commonly taught Parkland estimate: 4 mL x kg x %TBSA, with half in the first 8 hours from the burn time of 0600. The patient weighs 80 kg, has 31.5% TBSA burned, and arrives at 0640. Calculate the total 24-hour volume and the initial calculated rate from 0640 to 1400 before urine-output titration.
stem.zh: 医嘱按常用Parkland估算给予乳酸林格液：4 mL x kg x %TBSA，并从0600烧伤时间起前8小时输注一半。患者体重80 kg，烧伤31.5% TBSA，0640到达。请计算24小时总量，以及在根据尿量滴定前从0640至1400的初始计算速度。

correct.en: Total volume is 4 mL x 80 kg x 31.5 = 10,080 mL. Half is 5,040 mL due by 1400, which is 8 hours after the 0600 burn. Because the patient arrives 40 minutes after the burn, the remaining first-half window is 7 hours 20 minutes, or 7.33 hours. 5,040 mL divided by 7.33 hours is approximately 687 mL/hr, then the rate is titrated to urine output.
correct.zh: 总量为4 mL x 80 kg x 31.5 = 10,080 mL。前一半为5,040 mL，应在烧伤后8小时的1400前完成。患者在烧伤后40分钟到达，前半程剩余时间为7小时20分钟，即7.33小时。5,040 mL除以7.33小时约为687 mL/hr，随后根据尿量滴定。

byChoice.en: This blank tests the full Parkland estimate ordered in the case: 4 x 80 x 31.5.
byChoice.zh: 此空考查病例医嘱中的完整Parkland估算：4 x 80 x 31.5。

byChoice.en: This blank tests anchoring the first 8-hour window to the burn time, not the ED arrival time.
byChoice.zh: 此空考查前8小时窗口应从烧伤时间开始，而不是从到达急诊时间开始。

testTakingStrategy.en: For burn-fluid calculations, underline the burn time. The first-half clock starts at injury time, so late arrival means the remaining rate is higher than the simple 8-hour average.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做烧伤补液计算时，先划出烧伤时间。前一半液体的计时从受伤时间开始，因此延迟到院时，剩余时间内的速度会高于简单8小时平均速度。

glossary.defZh: 常用于烧伤初期晶体液复苏的平衡电解质溶液。
根据每小时尿量调整输液速度，以反映器官灌注是否足够。
烧伤后血管通透性增加，液体从血管内移向组织间隙。

stem.en: At 1000, the urine output has improved from 25 mL/hr to 35 mL/hr, but the ordered target is 40 to 80 mL/hr. The urine has lightened from dark amber to dark yellow. Which action should the nurse take?
stem.zh: 1000时尿量从25 mL/hr改善到35 mL/hr，但医嘱目标为40至80 mL/hr。尿液从深琥珀色变为深黄色。护士应采取哪项措施？

options.en: Increase the lactated Ringer's infusion rate per the titration protocol and reassess hourly.
options.zh: 按滴定方案增加乳酸林格液输注速度，并每小时重新评估。

options.en: Maintain the current rate because the urine color is improving.
options.zh: 因尿液颜色正在改善，维持当前速度。

options.en: Decrease the infusion rate to prevent fluid overload because the blood pressure is improving.
options.zh: 因血压正在改善，为预防液体过负荷而降低输注速度。

options.en: Stop titrating fluids and request a genitourinary workup for dark urine.
options.zh: 停止滴定液体，并因尿色深而要求泌尿系统检查。

correct.en: Urine output remains below the minimum target of 40 mL/hr, so the infusion should be increased per protocol and reassessed hourly. The urine color trend is reassuring but does not replace the urine-output target.
correct.zh: 尿量仍低于40 mL/hr的最低目标，因此应按方案增加输液速度并每小时重新评估。尿色改善是令人放心的趋势，但不能替代尿量目标。

byChoice.en: Fluid overload is not the immediate Stage 2 problem; the patient has not yet reached the urine-output target.
byChoice.zh: 液体过负荷不是阶段2的当前主要问题；患者尚未达到尿量目标。

byChoice.en: The urinalysis is negative for blood and red blood cells, and the priority is correcting low perfusion with protocol-driven resuscitation.
byChoice.zh: 尿液分析血和红细胞阴性，优先事项是按方案复苏以纠正低灌注。

byChoice.en: Increasing the rate addresses ongoing under-resuscitation because urine output remains below target.
byChoice.zh: 增加速度可处理仍然存在的复苏不足，因为尿量仍低于目标。

byChoice.en: Improving urine color is not enough; the actual hourly volume is still inadequate.
byChoice.zh: 尿色改善还不够；实际每小时尿量仍不足。

testTakingStrategy.en: Trend matters, but target range matters more. A value moving in the right direction is still abnormal if it has not reached the ordered endpoint.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 趋势重要，但目标范围更重要。数值即使朝正确方向变化，只要尚未达到医嘱终点，仍然异常。

glossary.defZh: 血流足以维持肾脏、脑、心脏等器官功能。
液体补充不足，可能导致休克、急性肾损伤和器官灌注不良。
烧伤复苏中用于动态评估肾灌注和液体充分性的关键指标。

stem.en: At 1800 to 2000, urine output is 110 to 120 mL/hr, new bilateral basilar crackles are present, peak airway pressures are rising, abdominal girth has increased, and the previously unburned hands are tense with delayed capillary refill. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 1800至2000期间，尿量为110至120 mL/hr，出现新的双侧肺底湿啰音，气道峰压升高，腹围增加，原本未烧伤的双手紧绷且毛细血管再充盈延迟。哪些护理措施合适？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Perform serial hand perfusion assessments including pulses, capillary refill, sensation, and swelling.
options.zh: 连续评估双手灌注，包括脉搏、毛细血管再充盈、感觉和肿胀。

options.en: Initiate or continue serial bladder pressure monitoring.
options.zh: 开始或继续连续监测膀胱压。

options.en: Notify the burn team about crackles, rising airway pressures, increasing abdominal girth, and extremity edema.
options.zh: 将湿啰音、气道峰压升高、腹围增加和肢体水肿通知烧伤团队。

options.en: Maintain or increase the infusion because the Parkland estimate covers 24 hours.
options.zh: 因为Parkland估算覆盖24小时，所以维持或增加输液。

options.en: Treat the crackles by increasing ventilator support without changing the fluid rate.
options.zh: 在不改变输液速度的情况下，通过增加呼吸机支持来处理湿啰音。

options.en: Reduce the lactated Ringer's infusion rate according to the titration order.
options.zh: 根据滴定医嘱降低乳酸林格液输注速度。

correct.en: The findings indicate fluid creep: urine output is above target and there are signs of pulmonary edema, increased intra-abdominal pressure risk, and extremity edema compromising perfusion. Appropriate nursing actions are to reduce the infusion per protocol, notify the burn team, monitor bladder pressure, and perform serial extremity perfusion assessments.
correct.zh: 这些发现提示液体蠕变/过度复苏：尿量高于目标，并出现肺水肿、腹内压升高风险和影响灌注的肢体水肿。合适的护理措施包括按方案降低输液速度、通知烧伤团队、监测膀胱压，并连续评估肢体灌注。

byChoice.en: Increasing abdominal girth during large-volume resuscitation requires monitoring for intra-abdominal hypertension.
byChoice.zh: 大量复苏期间腹围增加，需要监测腹内高压。

byChoice.en: Ventilator changes alone do not address the cause when the crackles and rising pressures are from volume overload.
byChoice.zh: 当湿啰音和气道压力升高源于容量过负荷时，仅调整呼吸机不能处理病因。

byChoice.en: Tense edema and delayed capillary refill in unburned hands require serial compartment and perfusion assessment.
byChoice.zh: 未烧伤双手紧绷水肿且毛细血管再充盈延迟，需要连续评估间隔室和灌注情况。

byChoice.en: The Parkland estimate is not a fixed-volume mandate; it must be titrated to the clinical endpoint.
byChoice.zh: Parkland估算不是固定必须输完的量；必须根据临床终点滴定。

byChoice.en: Urine output above the 40 to 80 mL/hr target shows that the current rate has overshot.
byChoice.zh: 尿量超过40至80 mL/hr目标，说明当前输液速度已经过高。

byChoice.en: The cluster suggests complications of over-resuscitation and requires burn-team evaluation.
byChoice.zh: 这一组表现提示过度复苏并发症，需要烧伤团队评估。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a treatment endpoint overshoots, reassess the treatment itself. High urine output plus new edema and crackles means the fluid rate may now be harmful.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当治疗终点超过目标时，要重新评估治疗本身。尿量过高并伴新发水肿和湿啰音，说明当前补液速度可能已经有害。

glossary.defZh: 液体积聚在肺间质或肺泡，可能表现为湿啰音和气道压力升高。
腹腔压力持续升高，可进展为腹腔间隔综合征。
组织压力升高导致血流和神经功能受损的急症。

correct.en: This case requires recognizing a high-risk burn patient with inhalation injury, calculating burn size accurately, applying the ordered Parkland estimate from the time of burn, titrating fluid to urine output, and later recognizing over-resuscitation. Early airway protection is prioritized because progressive hoarseness, stridor, drooling, carbonaceous sputum, and facial/oropharyngeal edema can progress to complete obstruction before oxygen saturation falls. The burn size is 31.5% TBSA because only anterior surfaces of the head/face, trunk, and arms are burned. Fluid therapy begins from the burn time and is adjusted to a urine output target of 40 to 80 mL/hr. Later excessive urine output with crackles, rising airway pressures, increased abdominal girth, edema of unburned hands, and hemodilution indicates fluid creep rather than successful resuscitation.
correct.zh: 本病例要求识别吸入性损伤高危烧伤患者，准确计算烧伤面积，按烧伤发生时间应用医嘱中的Parkland估算，依据尿量滴定液体，并在后期识别过度复苏。声音嘶哑加重、喘鸣、流涎、炭黑色痰以及面部/口咽水肿可在氧饱和度下降前进展为完全气道阻塞，因此需优先保护气道。烧伤面积为31.5% TBSA，因为仅头面部前侧、前躯干和双臂前侧烧伤。液体治疗从烧伤时间开始计算，并按40至80 mL/hr尿量目标调整。后期尿量过高，同时出现湿啰音、气道峰压升高、腹围增加、未烧伤双手水肿和血液稀释，提示液体蠕变/过度复苏，而不是复苏单纯成功。

testTakingStrategy.en: For burn case studies, separate the first threats in time: airway obstruction can kill before fluid calculations matter, then use TBSA and urine output to guide resuscitation, and finally reassess for complications of both under- and over-resuscitation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 处理烧伤案例时，要按时间顺序区分威胁：气道阻塞可能在液体计算发挥作用前致命；随后用TBSA和尿量指导复苏；最后同时评估复苏不足和过度复苏的并发症。

glossary.defZh: 用于表示烧伤覆盖身体面积百分比的指标，可指导液体复苏估算。
吸入热气、烟雾或有毒气体导致的气道或肺部损伤，可引起水肿和阻塞。
常用于烧伤初期晶体液复苏的计算方法；本病例按医嘱使用4 mL x kg x %TBSA。
烧伤复苏中实际输液量超过预期轨迹，导致肺水肿、腹内压升高或肢体水肿等并发症。
经导尿管测量的腹内压替代指标，用于监测腹内高压和腹腔间隔综合征风险。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Acute pulmonary embolism with right ventricular strain after total knee arthroplasty
title.zh: 全膝关节置换术后急性肺栓塞伴右心室负荷增加

summary.en: A 68-year-old man is on postoperative day 2 after an elective right total knee arthroplasty. He has obesity, a history of smoking, recent immobility, refusal of sequential compression devices overnight, and a missed morning ambulation attempt because of pain. He suddenly develops pleuritic chest pain, severe dyspnea, hypoxemia, tachycardia, diaphoresis, borderline hypotension, jugular venous distension, and a warm, swollen, tender right calf.
summary.zh: 一名68岁男性在择期右全膝关节置换术后第2天。患者有肥胖、既往吸烟史，近期活动减少，夜间拒绝使用间歇性充气压力装置，早晨因疼痛未能下床活动。随后突然出现吸气时胸痛、严重呼吸困难、低氧血症、心动过速、出汗、血压较基线偏低、颈静脉怒张，以及右小腿发热、肿胀和压痛。

content.en: Postoperative day 2 after right total knee arthroplasty. History: hypertension, hyperlipidemia, BMI 33, 30-pack-year smoking history, quit 5 years ago. No prior VTE or known coagulopathy. Postoperative VTE prophylaxis: enoxaparin 40 mg subcutaneously daily, SCDs to both legs, incentive spirometry every hour while awake, and early ambulation with physical therapy twice daily. Overnight documentation: refused SCDs at 2200 because they were uncomfortable; declined 0600 ambulation because knee pain was 7/10. Surgical drain removed on postoperative day 1 with minimal output. Wound dressing is clean, dry, and intact.
content.zh: 右全膝关节置换术后第2天。病史：高血压、高脂血症、BMI 33、30包年吸烟史，5年前戒烟。既往无静脉血栓栓塞或已知凝血障碍。术后VTE预防医嘱：依诺肝素40 mg皮下注射每日一次、双下肢SCD、清醒时每小时使用诱导肺量计、每日两次由物理治疗协助早期下床活动。夜班记录：22:00因觉得不舒服拒绝SCD；06:00因膝痛7/10拒绝下床活动。术后第1天拔除引流管，量少。手术敷料清洁、干燥、完整。

title.en: Baseline laboratory data from postoperative day 1
title.zh: 术后第1天基线实验室结果

content.en: WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL; hemoglobin 11.8 g/dL; hematocrit 35.4%; platelets 198 ×10³/µL; INR 1.0; aPTT 28 seconds; BUN 18 mg/dL; creatinine 0.9 mg/dL; eGFR >60 mL/min; sodium 139 mEq/L; potassium 4.1 mEq/L; glucose 142 mg/dL.
content.zh: WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL；血红蛋白11.8 g/dL；红细胞压积35.4%；血小板198 ×10³/µL；INR 1.0；aPTT 28秒；BUN 18 mg/dL；肌酐0.9 mg/dL；eGFR >60 mL/min；钠139 mEq/L；钾4.1 mEq/L；血糖142 mg/dL。

title.en: Stage 1: Initial recognition and rapid response
title.zh: 阶段1：初步识别与快速反应

title.en: Stage 1: Initial recognition and rapid response
title.zh: 阶段1：初步识别与快速反应

content.en: At 0815, the client says, "I can't catch my breath. It came on all of a sudden, and it hurts right here when I breathe in." He is pale, diaphoretic, anxious, and speaking in short phrases. Vital signs: T 37.2 C, HR 122/min regular, BP 100/70 mmHg from a preoperative baseline of 138/82, RR 28/min, SpO2 87% on room air. Lung sounds are clear bilaterally. JVD is visible at 45 degrees. The right calf is warm, erythematous, edematous, and tender; circumference is 42 cm on the right and 37 cm on the left. The surgical dressing is clean, dry, and intact. Urine output is 120 mL over 4 hours. The nurse applies oxygen, escalates to a non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min, activates the rapid response team, raises the head of the bed, establishes a second IV, places the client on continuous cardiac monitoring, and obtains a 12-lead ECG. ECG: sinus tachycardia, right-axis deviation, S1Q3T3 pattern, and T-wave inversions in V1-V3.
content.zh: 08:15，患者说：“我喘不过气，是突然发生的，吸气时这里会痛。”患者面色苍白、出汗、焦虑，只能说短句。生命体征：T 37.2 C，HR 122次/分且规则，BP 100/70 mmHg（术前基线138/82），RR 28次/分，室内空气下SpO2 87%。双肺呼吸音清。45度可见颈静脉怒张。右小腿发热、发红、肿胀和压痛；右侧周径42 cm，左侧37 cm。手术敷料清洁、干燥、完整。4小时尿量120 mL。护士给氧，并升级至15 L/min非再呼吸面罩，启动快速反应团队，抬高床头，建立第二条静脉通路，给予持续心电监护，并获取12导联心电图。心电图：窦性心动过速、右轴偏移、S1Q3T3表现，以及V1-V3导联T波倒置。

title.en: Stage 2: Diagnostic confirmation and initial treatment
title.zh: 阶段2：诊断确认与初始治疗

title.en: Stage 2: Diagnostic confirmation and initial treatment
title.zh: 阶段2：诊断确认与初始治疗

content.en: Stat results: troponin I 0.38 ng/mL, BNP 620 pg/mL, D-dimer >5,000 ng/mL FEU, hemoglobin 11.4 g/dL, platelets 192 ×10³/µL, aPTT 29 seconds, INR 1.0, creatinine 1.0 mg/dL, potassium 4.3 mEq/L, lactate 3.2 mmol/L. ABG on non-rebreather: pH 7.47, PaCO2 28 mmHg, PaO2 68 mmHg, HCO3 20 mEq/L, SaO2 93%. Chest x-ray shows no infiltrate, pneumothorax, or pleural effusion. CT pulmonary angiography shows a large saddle embolus extending into bilateral lobar arteries, RV/LV ratio 1.4, and interventricular septal bowing toward the left ventricle; no aortic dissection flap is seen. The provider orders UFH per facility PE protocol: 80 units/kg IV bolus, then 18 units/kg/hr infusion, aPTT every 6 hours, target aPTT 60-80 seconds. The orthopedic surgeon confirms no active surgical-site bleeding. The nurse gives the bolus at 0920 and starts the infusion. Repeat vital signs at 0930: HR 118/min, BP 98/66 mmHg, RR 28/min, SpO2 93% on non-rebreather. Urine output during the past hour is 20 mL.
content.zh: 急查结果：肌钙蛋白I 0.38 ng/mL，BNP 620 pg/mL，D-二聚体 >5,000 ng/mL FEU，血红蛋白11.4 g/dL，血小板192 ×10³/µL，aPTT 29秒，INR 1.0，肌酐1.0 mg/dL，钾4.3 mEq/L，乳酸3.2 mmol/L。非再呼吸面罩下ABG：pH 7.47，PaCO2 28 mmHg，PaO2 68 mmHg，HCO3 20 mEq/L，SaO2 93%。胸片未见浸润、气胸或胸腔积液。CT肺动脉造影显示大型骑跨型肺栓塞，延伸至双侧肺叶动脉，RV/LV比值1.4，室间隔向左心室弓形移位；未见主动脉夹层内膜片。医嘱按本机构PE方案给予UFH：80 units/kg静脉推注，随后18 units/kg/hr持续泵入，每6小时监测aPTT，目标aPTT 60-80秒。骨科医师确认手术部位无活动性出血。护士于09:20给予推注并开始泵入。09:30复查生命体征：HR 118次/分，BP 98/66 mmHg，RR 28次/分，非再呼吸面罩下SpO2 93%。过去1小时尿量20 mL。

title.en: Stage 3: ICU monitoring and response to therapy
Stage 3: ICU monitoring and response to therapy

content.en: The pulmonary team classifies the PE as intermediate-risk/submassive because of RV strain and positive biomarkers without sustained SBP below 90 mmHg. Systemic thrombolysis is not ordered because the client is hemodynamically stable and is postoperative day 2 from major orthopedic surgery. The plan is ICU transfer, therapeutic UFH, close monitoring, and escalation if sustained hypotension or obstructive shock develops. At 1000: chest pain 6/10, HR 112/min, BP 102/70 mmHg, RR 26/min, SpO2 94% on non-rebreather, urine output 25 mL over 30 minutes. At 1200: HR 106/min, BP 108/72 mmHg, RR 24/min, SpO2 95% on non-rebreather, chest pain 4/10, speaking in full sentences, urine output 35 mL/hr over the past 2 hours. The surgical dressing remains clean, dry, and intact. At 1330: troponin I 0.42 ng/mL and lactate 2.4 mmol/L. The first aPTT is scheduled for 1520, and repeat echocardiography is planned in 24 hours.
content.zh: 肺科团队将PE归类为中危/次大面积PE，因为有右心负荷增加和心肌标志物阳性，但没有持续性收缩压低于90 mmHg。由于患者血流动力学稳定且为大型骨科手术后第2天，未给予全身溶栓。计划转入ICU、继续治疗剂量UFH、严密监测，并在出现持续低血压或梗阻性休克时升级处理。10:00：胸痛6/10，HR 112次/分，BP 102/70 mmHg，RR 26次/分，非再呼吸面罩下SpO2 94%，30分钟尿量25 mL。12:00：HR 106次/分，BP 108/72 mmHg，RR 24次/分，非再呼吸面罩下SpO2 95%，胸痛4/10，能说完整句子，过去2小时尿量35 mL/hr。手术敷料仍清洁、干燥、完整。13:30：肌钙蛋白I 0.42 ng/mL，乳酸2.4 mmol/L。首次aPTT计划15:20抽血，24小时后计划复查超声心动图。

stem.en: Highlight the findings that are most concerning for acute pulmonary embolism with possible right ventricular compromise.
stem.zh: 请标出最提示急性肺栓塞并可能伴右心室受累的发现。

segments.en: Postoperative day 2 after right total knee arthroplasty.
segments.zh: 右全膝关节置换术后第2天。

segments.en: Refused SCDs overnight and declined morning ambulation because of knee pain.
segments.zh: 夜间拒绝SCD，早晨因膝痛拒绝下床活动。

segments.en: Sudden onset of dyspnea and pleuritic right-sided chest pain.
segments.zh: 突然出现呼吸困难和右侧吸气性胸痛。

segments.en: Temperature 99 °F (37.2 °C).
Heart rate 122/min.
segments.zh: 心率122次/分。

segments.en: Blood pressure 100/70 mmHg, below preoperative baseline 138/82 mmHg.
segments.zh: 血压100/70 mmHg，低于术前基线138/82 mmHg。

segments.en: SpO2 87% on room air.
segments.zh: 室内空气下SpO2 87%。

segments.en: Lung sounds clear bilaterally.
segments.zh: 双肺呼吸音清。

segments.en: Visible jugular venous distension at 45 degrees.
segments.zh: 45度可见颈静脉怒张。

segments.en: Surgical dressing clean, dry, and intact.
segments.zh: 手术敷料清洁、干燥、完整。

segments.en: Right calf warm, erythematous, edematous, and tender with a 5-cm larger circumference than the left.
segments.zh: 右小腿发热、发红、肿胀和压痛，周径比左侧大5 cm。

segments.en: Client is pale, diaphoretic, anxious, and speaking in short phrases.
segments.zh: 患者面色苍白、出汗、焦虑，只能说短句。

correct.en: The key cue cluster is sudden pleuritic chest pain, severe dyspnea and hypoxemia, tachycardia, diaphoresis and pallor, blood pressure below baseline, JVD, and unilateral calf findings in a postoperative client with immobility and refusal of SCDs. These findings collectively point to acute PE with DVT source and possible RV strain.
correct.zh: 关键线索组合是术后患者有活动减少和拒绝SCD，同时突然出现吸气性胸痛、严重呼吸困难和低氧、心动过速、出汗和苍白、血压低于基线、颈静脉怒张以及单侧小腿异常。这些发现共同指向急性PE，可能来源于DVT，并可能已有右心负荷增加。

byChoice.en: Recent major orthopedic surgery is a strong VTE risk factor.
byChoice.zh: 近期大型骨科手术是VTE的重要危险因素。

byChoice.en: Immobility and refusal of mechanical prophylaxis increase concern for postoperative VTE.
byChoice.zh: 活动减少并拒绝机械预防会增加术后VTE的风险。

byChoice.en: Abrupt dyspnea with pleuritic chest pain is a classic PE presentation and requires immediate escalation.
byChoice.zh: 突然呼吸困难伴吸气性胸痛是PE的典型表现，需要立即升级处理。

byChoice.en: A normal temperature does not explain the acute hypoxemia and chest pain and is not a priority PE cue.
byChoice.zh: 正常体温不能解释急性低氧和胸痛，不是本题优先的PE线索。

byChoice.en: Tachycardia is a compensatory response to hypoxemia and obstructive strain in acute PE.
byChoice.zh: 心动过速是急性PE中对低氧和梗阻性负荷增加的代偿反应。

byChoice.en: A blood pressure below baseline suggests early hemodynamic compromise even though SBP is still above 90 mmHg.
byChoice.zh: 血压低于基线提示早期血流动力学受影响，即使收缩压仍高于90 mmHg。

byChoice.en: Severe hypoxemia on room air is a priority cardiopulmonary cue.
byChoice.zh: 室内空气下明显低氧是优先处理的心肺线索。

byChoice.en: Clear lung sounds help move pneumonia or pulmonary edema lower in the differential, but they are not a priority cue for PE severity.
byChoice.zh: 双肺清音可使肺炎或肺水肿可能性降低，但不是判断PE严重程度的优先线索。

byChoice.en: JVD suggests elevated right-sided pressures from RV strain.
byChoice.zh: 颈静脉怒张提示右心压力升高和右心室负荷增加。

byChoice.en: An intact dressing helps reduce concern for active surgical bleeding, but it does not explain the acute cardiopulmonary event.
byChoice.zh: 敷料完整可降低对活动性手术出血的担忧，但不能解释急性心肺事件。

byChoice.en: Unilateral calf warmth, swelling, and tenderness suggest DVT as the embolic source.
byChoice.zh: 单侧小腿发热、肿胀和压痛提示DVT，可能是栓子的来源。

byChoice.en: Diaphoresis, pallor, and short-phrase speech signal acute distress and impaired oxygenation/perfusion.
byChoice.zh: 出汗、苍白和只能说短句提示急性危重状态以及氧合/灌注受损。

testTakingStrategy.en: Cluster cues rather than evaluating them one at a time. A postoperative client with sudden pleuritic dyspnea plus unilateral calf findings is a PE emergency until proven otherwise.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 要把线索组合起来判断，而不是逐条孤立分析。术后患者突然出现吸气性胸痛/呼吸困难并伴单侧小腿异常，应先按PE急症处理。

glossary.defZh: 吸气、咳嗽或胸膜受牵拉时加重的胸痛。
通过周期性加压下肢帮助静脉回流、降低术后血栓风险的装置。
颈静脉充盈明显，提示右心压力升高或容量负荷异常。

stem.en: Classify how each finding contributes to the nurse's interpretation of the confirmed pulmonary embolism.
stem.zh: 请分类每项发现如何帮助护士解释已确认的肺栓塞。

rows.en: Troponin I 0.38 ng/mL and BNP 620 pg/mL
rows.zh: 肌钙蛋白I 0.38 ng/mL和BNP 620 pg/mL

rows.en: CT-PA shows RV/LV ratio 1.4 with septal bowing
rows.zh: CT肺动脉造影显示RV/LV比值1.4并有室间隔移位

rows.en: ECG shows S1Q3T3 and T-wave inversions in V1-V3
rows.zh: 心电图显示S1Q3T3和V1-V3导联T波倒置

rows.en: ABG shows pH 7.47, PaCO2 28, PaO2 68 on non-rebreather
rows.zh: 非再呼吸面罩下ABG显示pH 7.47、PaCO2 28、PaO2 68

rows.en: D-dimer >5,000 ng/mL FEU in a postoperative client
rows.zh: 术后患者D-二聚体 >5,000 ng/mL FEU

rows.en: Systolic blood pressure remains above 90 mmHg
rows.zh: 收缩压仍维持在90 mmHg以上

columns.zh: 支持右心负荷增加/中危PE
此处不能区分严重程度

correct.en: The positive cardiac biomarkers, CT evidence of RV dilation and septal bowing, ECG signs of right heart strain, and hypoxemia/respiratory alkalosis support intermediate-risk PE with RV compromise. The D-dimer is elevated but expected after surgery and does not classify severity. The SBP remaining above 90 mmHg prevents classification as massive/high-risk PE at this moment.
correct.zh: 心肌标志物阳性、CT显示右心室扩大和室间隔移位、心电图提示右心负荷增加，以及低氧/呼吸性碱中毒，均支持中危PE伴右心受累。D-二聚体升高但术后常见，不能用于区分严重程度。收缩压仍高于90 mmHg，因此此时不能归类为大面积/高危PE。

byChoice.en: Troponin and BNP elevation indicate myocardial injury and RV pressure strain from the PE.
byChoice.zh: 肌钙蛋白和BNP升高提示PE造成心肌损伤和右心压力负荷增加。

byChoice.en: An RV/LV ratio above normal and septal bowing show RV dilation and pressure overload.
byChoice.zh: RV/LV比值升高和室间隔移位显示右心室扩大和压力负荷增加。

byChoice.en: S1Q3T3 and right precordial T-wave inversions fit acute right heart strain rather than a primary left-sided coronary pattern.
byChoice.zh: S1Q3T3和右胸前导联T波倒置符合急性右心负荷增加，而不是原发左侧冠脉事件。

byChoice.en: Respiratory alkalosis with persistent hypoxemia despite high-flow oxygen reflects significant ventilation-perfusion mismatch.
byChoice.zh: 高流量给氧下仍有低氧并伴呼吸性碱中毒，反映明显通气/灌注不匹配。

byChoice.en: D-dimer is nonspecific after surgery; it supports clot turnover but does not grade PE severity.
byChoice.zh: 术后D-二聚体缺乏特异性，可支持存在凝血/纤溶活动，但不能分级PE严重程度。

byChoice.en: Massive/high-risk PE depends on hemodynamic instability; SBP above 90 mmHg keeps this case in the intermediate-risk category.
byChoice.zh: 大面积/高危PE取决于血流动力学不稳定；收缩压高于90 mmHg使本病例仍属中危。

testTakingStrategy.en: Separate diagnostic confirmation from severity classification. In PE, RV dysfunction and positive biomarkers without sustained hypotension point to intermediate-risk/submassive PE.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 要区分“诊断确认”和“严重程度分级”。PE中，若有右心功能受累和心肌标志物阳性，但没有持续低血压，应考虑中危/次大面积PE。

glossary.defZh: 心室壁压力增加时释放的标志物，可提示心室负荷增加。
影像学用于评估右心室是否扩大和受压的指标。
过度通气导致PaCO2下降、pH升高的酸碱状态。

stem.en: After reviewing the ECG, chest x-ray, CT-PA, and clinical findings, which condition should the nurse prioritize as the primary problem?
stem.zh: 护士查看心电图、胸片、CT肺动脉造影和临床发现后，应优先判断哪一项是主要问题？

options.en: ST-elevation myocardial infarction requiring immediate coronary catheterization
options.zh: ST段抬高型心肌梗死，需要立即冠脉导管介入

options.en: Aortic dissection requiring impulse control and surgical evaluation
options.zh: 主动脉夹层，需要控制心率/血压并外科评估

options.en: Pulmonary embolism with right ventricular strain
options.zh: 肺栓塞伴右心室负荷增加

options.en: Postoperative atelectasis requiring incentive spirometry and reassurance
options.zh: 术后肺不张，需要诱导肺量计和安慰

correct.en: The unilateral calf findings, recent orthopedic surgery with reduced prophylaxis adherence, sudden pleuritic dyspnea, hypoxemia, CT-confirmed saddle embolus, elevated RV strain biomarkers, and right-heart-strain ECG findings make pulmonary embolism with RV strain the primary condition.
correct.zh: 单侧小腿异常、近期骨科手术且预防依从性不足、突然吸气性胸痛和呼吸困难、低氧、CT证实骑跨型栓塞、右心负荷标志物升高以及心电图右心受累表现，使肺栓塞伴右心室负荷增加成为主要问题。

byChoice.en: Atelectasis can occur after surgery, but it would not explain the acute pleuritic pain, severe hypoxemia, JVD, unilateral calf findings, or CT-confirmed saddle embolus.
byChoice.zh: 术后可发生肺不张，但不能解释急性吸气性胸痛、严重低氧、颈静脉怒张、单侧小腿异常或CT确认的骑跨型栓塞。

byChoice.en: This integrates the postoperative VTE risk, DVT signs, respiratory presentation, CT-PA confirmation, biomarkers, and ECG pattern.
byChoice.zh: 该选项整合了术后VTE风险、DVT体征、呼吸表现、CT肺动脉造影确认、标志物和心电图表现。

byChoice.en: Troponin is elevated, but the ECG pattern reflects right heart strain rather than ST elevation in a coronary distribution, and CT-PA confirms PE.
byChoice.zh: 肌钙蛋白虽升高，但心电图表现为右心负荷增加，而不是冠脉供血区域ST段抬高；且CT肺动脉造影已确认PE。

byChoice.en: CT-PA reports no aortic dissection flap, and the presentation is pleuritic with DVT signs rather than tearing pain or pulse/BP differential.
byChoice.zh: CT肺动脉造影未见主动脉夹层内膜片；表现为吸气性胸痛并伴DVT线索，而不是撕裂样疼痛或两侧脉搏/血压差异。

testTakingStrategy.en: When chest pain has multiple dangerous differentials, use the diagnostic test that directly identifies the life threat. CT-PA showing a saddle embolus outranks nonspecific troponin elevation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 胸痛有多个危险鉴别诊断时，要用能直接确认威胁生命问题的检查来判断。CT肺动脉造影显示骑跨型栓塞，比非特异性肌钙蛋白升高更有决定性。

glossary.defZh: 使用增强CT显示肺动脉内栓子，是诊断PE的重要影像学检查。
冠状动脉急性闭塞导致的心肌梗死，心电图出现相应导联ST段抬高。
主动脉内膜撕裂，血液进入血管壁层间形成假腔的急症。

stem.en: Which statements best explain the appropriateness of the current treatment plan? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 以下哪些陈述最能解释当前治疗计划的适当性？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Recent major orthopedic surgery increases the bleeding risk of systemic thrombolysis while the client remains hemodynamically stable.
options.zh: 近期大型骨科手术会增加全身溶栓出血风险，而患者目前血流动力学仍稳定。

options.en: Protamine sulfate can reverse UFH more completely than it reverses LMWH.
options.zh: 鱼精蛋白对UFH的逆转作用比对LMWH更完全。

options.en: Systemic thrombolysis is indicated now because a saddle embolus is large, even without sustained hypotension.
options.zh: 即使没有持续低血压，因骑跨型栓塞体积大，现在也应给予全身溶栓。

options.en: Therapeutic anticoagulation should be withheld until the chest pain completely resolves.
options.zh: 应等胸痛完全缓解后再开始治疗性抗凝。

options.en: UFH can be titrated quickly and has a short half-life, which is helpful if bleeding or urgent intervention occurs.
options.zh: UFH可快速调整剂量且半衰期短，若发生出血或需要紧急介入会更有利。

options.en: If sustained hypotension or obstructive shock develops, escalation to catheter-directed therapy or surgical embolectomy may be considered.
options.zh: 如果出现持续低血压或梗阻性休克，可考虑升级为导管定向治疗或外科取栓。

correct.en: UFH is a reasonable facility-protocol choice in this high bleeding-risk postoperative context because it can be titrated, stopped quickly, and reversed. Systemic thrombolysis is not the current priority because the client is intermediate-risk/submassive rather than massive/high-risk and is only 2 days from major orthopedic surgery. If he develops sustained hypotension or obstructive shock, escalation to advanced reperfusion options may be considered.
correct.zh: 在这种术后出血风险较高的情境中，按机构方案选择UFH是合理的，因为它可调整、可较快停止且可逆转。当前不优先全身溶栓，因为患者属于中危/次大面积PE而非大面积/高危PE，并且距大型骨科手术仅2天。如果出现持续低血压或梗阻性休克，可考虑升级至高级再灌注治疗。

byChoice.en: Deterioration to sustained hypotension or obstructive shock would change the risk-benefit balance and prompt rapid provider escalation.
byChoice.zh: 若恶化为持续低血压或梗阻性休克，风险-收益平衡会改变，需要迅速通知医师升级处理。

byChoice.en: Short half-life and titratability are safety advantages when bleeding risk or urgent procedures are possible.
byChoice.zh: 在存在出血风险或可能需要紧急操作时，半衰期短和可调整剂量是安全优势。

byChoice.en: UFH is more readily reversible with protamine than LMWH, which matters after recent surgery.
byChoice.zh: UFH较LMWH更容易被鱼精蛋白逆转，这对近期术后患者很重要。

byChoice.en: Clot size alone does not mandate systemic thrombolysis; hemodynamic instability and bleeding risk drive that decision.
byChoice.zh: 仅凭血栓体积大并不一定需要全身溶栓；是否血流动力学不稳定和出血风险才是关键。

byChoice.en: Delaying anticoagulation until pain resolves would allow clot propagation and recurrent embolization risk to persist.
byChoice.zh: 等胸痛完全缓解才抗凝会延误治疗，使血栓继续扩展或再次栓塞的风险持续存在。

byChoice.en: Recent major surgery makes systemic thrombolysis high risk when the PE is not immediately life-threatening from sustained shock.
byChoice.zh: 近期大型手术使全身溶栓出血风险很高；若PE未造成持续休克，不应轻易使用。

testTakingStrategy.en: For medication choices, look for the clinical context that modifies the usual rule. Recent surgery shifts the focus to reversibility, titration, and bleeding surveillance.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 药物选择题要找出会改变常规选择的临床情境。近期手术会使重点转向可逆转性、剂量可调性和出血监测。

glossary.defZh: 用于治疗已存在血栓或防止血栓扩展的抗凝强度，高于预防剂量。
用于逆转肝素抗凝作用的药物。
通过血管内导管对血栓进行局部溶栓或机械处理的治疗方式。

stem.en: The UFH bolus and infusion have been ordered. Which nursing actions are appropriate now? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 已医嘱给予UFH推注和持续泵入。此时哪些护理措施合适？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Maintain continuous cardiac monitoring and prepare for ICU transfer.
options.zh: 持续心电监护并准备转入ICU。

options.en: Administer the ordered UFH bolus and begin the infusion without delaying for ICU transfer.
options.zh: 给予医嘱的UFH推注并开始泵入，不因等待ICU转运而延误。

options.en: Place the client supine or in Trendelenburg to increase venous return and improve blood pressure.
options.zh: 将患者置于平卧位或Trendelenburg位，以增加静脉回流并改善血压。

options.en: Maintain the non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min with continuous SpO2 monitoring.
options.zh: 维持15 L/min非再呼吸面罩并持续监测SpO2。

options.en: Keep the head of the bed elevated in high Fowler's or a semi-recumbent position.
options.zh: 保持高Fowler位或半卧位。

options.en: Assess and document the surgical site for new bleeding or expanding hematoma after anticoagulation begins.
options.zh: 开始抗凝后评估并记录手术部位是否有新出血或扩大血肿。

correct.en: The nurse should start ordered therapeutic anticoagulation promptly, continue high-flow oxygen with SpO2 monitoring, keep the client upright or semi-recumbent to support ventilation and avoid worsening RV overload, monitor continuously, prepare for ICU transfer, and assess for postoperative bleeding after anticoagulation begins. These interventions are concurrent; ICU transfer preparation should not delay anticoagulation or oxygen support.
correct.zh: 护士应及时开始医嘱的治疗性抗凝，继续高流量给氧并监测SpO2，保持坐起或半卧位以支持通气并避免加重右心负荷，持续监护，准备转入ICU，并在开始抗凝后评估术后出血。这些措施可并行进行；准备转运ICU不应延误抗凝或给氧。

byChoice.en: Therapeutic anticoagulation after recent surgery requires active surveillance for wound bleeding or hematoma.
byChoice.zh: 近期术后给予治疗性抗凝时，必须主动观察伤口出血或血肿。

byChoice.en: An upright or semi-recumbent position supports ventilation and avoids unnecessary increases in venous return to a strained RV.
byChoice.zh: 坐起或半卧位有助于通气，并避免不必要地增加已受压右心室的静脉回流。

byChoice.en: Anticoagulation is time-sensitive in confirmed PE and should not be delayed by transfer logistics.
byChoice.zh: 已确认PE时抗凝具有时间敏感性，不应因转运流程而延误。

byChoice.en: Continuous monitoring and ICU transfer are appropriate because intermediate-risk PE can deteriorate rapidly.
byChoice.zh: 中危PE可能迅速恶化，因此持续监护和转入ICU是合适的。

byChoice.en: Supine or Trendelenburg positioning can worsen RV distension and compromise LV filling in obstructive physiology.
byChoice.zh: 平卧或Trendelenburg位可能加重右心室扩张，并在梗阻性生理状态下降低左心室充盈。

byChoice.en: Persistent hypoxemia requires ongoing oxygen support and close saturation monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 持续低氧需要继续氧疗并密切监测血氧饱和度。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several urgent actions are safe and concurrent, select all actions that address immediate threats: oxygenation, clot propagation, hemodynamic monitoring, and bleeding surveillance.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当多个紧急措施可以安全并行时，选择能处理立即威胁的措施：氧合、血栓扩展、血流动力学监测和出血观察。

glossary.defZh: 可提供高浓度氧气的面罩，常用于急性低氧。
血液在组织内积聚形成的肿块，抗凝后风险增加。
血流受到机械性阻塞导致心输出量受限的状态，如大肺栓塞。

stem.en: Complete the nurse's interpretation of the client's response to therapy.
stem.zh: 请完成护士对患者治疗反应的判断。

clozeStem.en: At 1330, the client's overall trajectory is {{1}} because {{2}}. The slight troponin increase from 0.38 to 0.42 ng/mL should be interpreted as {{3}}, so the nurse should {{4}}.
clozeStem.zh: 13:30时，患者总体趋势为 {{1}}，因为 {{2}}。肌钙蛋白从0.38小幅升至0.42 ng/mL应理解为 {{3}}，因此护士应 {{4}}。

options.en: ready for discharge teaching
options.zh: 已准备进行出院宣教

options.en: rapidly deteriorating
options.zh: 正在快速恶化

options.en: improving
options.zh: 正在改善

options.en: heart rate, blood pressure, oxygenation, urine output, lactate, and pain are trending in the right direction
options.zh: 心率、血压、氧合、尿量、乳酸和疼痛均向好转方向变化

options.en: D-dimer is elevated and confirms that anticoagulation has dissolved the clot
options.zh: D-二聚体升高，证实抗凝已溶解血栓

options.en: the client no longer requires a non-rebreather mask
options.zh: 患者已不再需要非再呼吸面罩

options.en: an expected biomarker trend that does not outweigh the improving clinical status
options.zh: 预期的标志物变化，不能压过整体临床好转趋势

options.en: proof that systemic thrombolysis is now required
options.zh: 证明现在必须进行全身溶栓

options.en: evidence that the primary problem is STEMI instead of PE
options.zh: 提示主要问题是STEMI而不是PE

options.en: continue the current plan and monitor for hypotension, worsening hypoxemia, decreased level of consciousness, low urine output, and bleeding
options.zh: 继续当前计划，并监测低血压、低氧加重、意识水平下降、尿量减少和出血

options.en: request immediate systemic thrombolysis based only on the troponin trend
options.zh: 仅根据肌钙蛋白趋势要求立即全身溶栓

options.en: stop the UFH infusion because the chest pain has improved
options.zh: 因胸痛改善而停止UFH泵入

correct.en: The overall trajectory is improving: heart rate is lower, blood pressure is higher, SpO2 and respiratory rate are improved, pain has decreased, urine output has recovered, and lactate has fallen. A small troponin rise can occur after the initial RV strain and does not by itself indicate deterioration when bedside perfusion and oxygenation data are improving. The client still requires ICU monitoring and therapeutic anticoagulation.
correct.zh: 总体趋势是改善：心率下降、血压上升、SpO2和呼吸频率改善、疼痛减轻、尿量恢复、乳酸下降。右心室最初受压后肌钙蛋白可能小幅继续升高；如果床旁灌注和氧合资料正在改善，单独的肌钙蛋白变化并不代表恶化。患者仍需ICU监测和治疗性抗凝。

byChoice.en: The correct trajectory is improving, not deteriorating or discharge-ready, because the client remains on high-flow oxygen and early therapeutic anticoagulation.
byChoice.zh: 正确总体判断是正在改善，而不是恶化或可出院，因为患者仍需高流量氧和早期治疗性抗凝。

byChoice.en: Improving hemodynamics, oxygenation, symptoms, urine output, and lactate are the bedside response indicators; D-dimer does not track acute response.
byChoice.zh: 血流动力学、氧合、症状、尿量和乳酸改善才是床旁反应指标；D-二聚体不能追踪急性治疗反应。

byChoice.en: The small troponin rise is interpreted in context and does not override the improving clinical trend.
byChoice.zh: 肌钙蛋白小幅升高需结合情境解释，不能推翻整体临床好转趋势。

byChoice.en: The nurse should continue treatment and monitor for deterioration and bleeding, not escalate or stop UFH based on one isolated marker.
byChoice.zh: 护士应继续治疗并监测恶化和出血，而不是根据单一指标升级治疗或停止UFH。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate outcomes by trend clusters, not by one isolated abnormal value. In acute PE, bedside perfusion and oxygenation trends carry more immediate weight than a small early biomarker rise.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估疗效要看一组趋势，而不是单个异常值。急性PE中，床旁灌注和氧合趋势比早期单个标志物小幅升高更有即时意义。

glossary.defZh: 组织灌注不足或缺氧时可升高的代谢指标。
某项实验室标志物随时间升高、达峰或下降的规律。
心率、血压、尿量和灌注等指标随时间的变化方向。

correct.en: This case follows the clinical judgment arc for a postoperative pulmonary embolism. The initial cues are the abrupt pleuritic chest pain, dyspnea, hypoxemia, tachycardia, diaphoresis, blood pressure below baseline, JVD, and unilateral calf warmth, swelling, and tenderness after recent orthopedic surgery and reduced mobility. Diagnostic data then confirm a saddle PE with RV strain: elevated troponin and BNP, respiratory alkalosis with persistent hypoxemia, S1Q3T3 and right precordial T-wave inversions, and CT evidence of RV dilation and septal bowing. Because the client remains without sustained SBP below 90 mmHg, the PE is intermediate-risk/submassive rather than massive/high-risk. Priority nursing care is to support oxygenation, avoid positions that could worsen RV overload, administer the ordered UFH bolus and infusion, monitor for bleeding after therapeutic anticoagulation, and reassess for deterioration requiring escalation. The later data show improvement because heart rate, blood pressure, oxygenation, urine output, lactate, and symptoms are trending favorably despite a small expected troponin rise.
correct.zh: 本病例体现术后肺栓塞的临床判断过程。最初的关键线索是突然出现的吸气性胸痛、呼吸困难、低氧血症、心动过速、出汗、血压低于基线、颈静脉怒张，以及近期骨科手术和活动减少后出现的单侧小腿发热、肿胀和压痛。随后诊断资料证实骑跨型肺栓塞伴右心负荷增加：肌钙蛋白和BNP升高、呼吸性碱中毒伴持续低氧血症、S1Q3T3及右胸前导联T波倒置，以及CT显示右心室扩大和室间隔移位。由于没有持续性收缩压低于90 mmHg，该PE属于中危/次大面积，而不是大面积/高危。护理重点是支持氧合，避免可能加重右心室容量负荷的体位，按医嘱给予UFH推注和泵入，治疗性抗凝后监测出血，并持续评估是否恶化需要升级治疗。后续资料显示总体改善，因为心率、血压、氧合、尿量、乳酸和症状均向好转趋势发展，尽管肌钙蛋白小幅升高。

testTakingStrategy.en: In postoperative chest pain and dyspnea questions, do not anchor on anxiety or atelectasis when the client has sudden pleuritic pain, hypoxemia, tachycardia, unilateral calf findings, and signs of right-sided strain. Use the hemodynamic status to separate intermediate-risk PE from massive/high-risk PE.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到术后胸痛和呼吸困难题时，如果同时有突然吸气性胸痛、低氧、心动过速、单侧小腿异常和右心负荷增加表现，不要锚定为焦虑或肺不张。用血流动力学状态区分中危PE和大面积/高危PE。

glossary.defZh: 血栓或其他栓子阻塞肺动脉，导致通气/灌注不匹配、低氧血症，并可造成右心室负荷增加。
肺循环阻力急剧增加导致右心室扩张、压力负荷增加和心肌损伤标志物升高。
栓子位于肺动脉主干分叉处，可延伸至双侧肺动脉分支。
可静脉给药并通过aPTT或抗Xa监测的抗凝药，半衰期短，可用鱼精蛋白逆转。
使用药物溶解血栓的治疗方式，可能快速改善阻塞，但会显著增加出血风险。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Acute variceal hemorrhage in decompensated alcohol-related cirrhosis
title.zh: 失代偿性酒精相关肝硬化中的急性静脉曲张出血

summary.en: A 55-year-old man with alcohol-related cirrhosis, portal hypertension, known esophageal varices, ascites, and intermittent hepatic encephalopathy presents with large-volume bright red hematemesis, hypotension, tachycardia, and evidence of impaired hepatic synthetic function.
summary.zh: 一名55岁男性，有酒精相关肝硬化、门静脉高压、已知食管静脉曲张、腹水和间歇性肝性脑病。现因大量鲜红色呕血、低血压、心动过速以及肝脏合成功能受损表现来诊。

content.en: Known Child-Pugh B alcohol-related cirrhosis. Prior screening EGD showed grade II esophageal varices 18 months ago. He has ascites managed with furosemide and spironolactone, mild intermittent hepatic encephalopathy treated with lactulose, no anticoagulants, no NSAIDs, and no beta-blocker because baseline systolic pressures were in the low 90s.
content.zh: 已知Child-Pugh B级酒精相关肝硬化。18个月前筛查胃镜显示II级食管静脉曲张。腹水使用呋塞米和螺内酯管理，轻度间歇性肝性脑病使用乳果糖治疗；未使用抗凝药或NSAID，也未因基础收缩压在90 mmHg出头而使用β受体阻滞剂。

content.en: Large-volume bright red hematemesis occurred about 45 minutes before arrival, with another episode during transport. Vitals: T 36.8 C, HR 118, BP 88/54, RR 20, SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. He is pale and diaphoretic with dried blood around the mouth. Abdomen is distended with fluid wave and shifting dullness. Caput medusae, spider angiomata, scleral icterus, and 2+ lower-extremity edema are present. He is alert and oriented with no asterixis.
content.zh: 到院前约45分钟出现大量鲜红色呕血，途中再次呕血。生命体征：T 36.8 C，HR 118，BP 88/54，RR 20，鼻导管2 L/min下SpO2 96%。患者苍白、出汗，口周有干血迹。腹部膨隆，有液波震颤和移动性浊音。可见海蛇头样静脉曲张、蜘蛛痣、巩膜黄染和双下肢2+水肿。患者清醒定向，无扑翼样震颤。

content.en: Hgb 8.1 g/dL, Hct 24.3%, platelets 72 ×10³/µL, WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL, Na 131 mEq/L, K 3.6 mEq/L, BUN 32 mg/dL, creatinine 1.3 mg/dL (baseline 1.0), total bilirubin 3.8 mg/dL, albumin 2.4 g/dL, INR 1.9, lactate 3.4 mmol/L, ammonia 62 µmol/L. Type and screen sent; crossmatch ordered for 4 units PRBC.
content.zh: Hgb 8.1 g/dL，Hct 24.3%，血小板72 ×10³/µL，WBC 6.2 ×10³/µL，Na 131 mEq/L，K 3.6 mEq/L，BUN 32 mg/dL，肌酐1.3 mg/dL（基础1.0），总胆红素3.8 mg/dL，白蛋白2.4 g/dL，INR 1.9，乳酸3.4 mmol/L，氨62 µmol/L。已送血型筛查；已申请4单位红细胞交叉配血。

content.en: Two 16-gauge IVs are placed. A 500 mL normal saline bolus is started. Orders include octreotide 50 mcg IV bolus then 50 mcg/hr infusion, ceftriaxone 1 g IV daily, pantoprazole infusion, NPO status, NG tube placement, and emergent GI consult. NG tube returns bright red blood with clots. After the bolus, HR 112, BP 92/58, and the patient vomits another 200 mL bright red blood. Point-of-care Hgb is 7.2 g/dL, lactate rises to 4.1 mmol/L, and urine output is 25 mL in the first hour. The provider orders 1 unit PRBC with target Hgb 7-8 g/dL.
content.zh: 置入两条16G外周静脉通路，开始500 mL生理盐水快速输注。医嘱包括奥曲肽50 mcg静推后以50 mcg/hr泵入、头孢曲松1 g IV每日一次、泮托拉唑泵入、禁食、置入胃管和急诊消化科会诊。胃管引出鲜红色血液和小血块。补液后HR 112，BP 92/58，患者再次呕出约200 mL鲜红色血液。床旁Hgb 7.2 g/dL，乳酸升至4.1 mmol/L，第1小时尿量25 mL。医嘱输注1单位红细胞，目标Hgb 7-8 g/dL。

title.en: Stage 2: 90 minutes to 4 hours after arrival
title.zh: 第2阶段：到院后90分钟至4小时

title.en: Stage 2: 90 minutes to 4 hours after arrival
title.zh: 第2阶段：到院后90分钟至4小时

content.en: Emergent EGD under airway protection shows three columns of large distal esophageal varices with active spurting from one varix and a red wale sign on another. Six bands are placed and hemostasis is achieved. In the ICU, HR 96, BP 104/62, RR 16, SpO2 98% on 2 L. Post-transfusion Hgb is 7.8 g/dL, lactate 2.6 mmol/L, urine output 40 mL/hr. He is drowsy but arousable and oriented. No further hematemesis. Small melena is noted. Four-hour labs show creatinine 1.5 mg/dL, INR 2.0, platelets 68 ×10³/µL, and ammonia 78 µmol/L.
content.zh: 气道保护下急诊胃镜显示远端食管三列大型静脉曲张，其中一处活动性喷射出血，另一处有红色征；置入6个套扎环后止血成功。入ICU时HR 96，BP 104/62，RR 16，2 L吸氧下SpO2 98%。输血后Hgb 7.8 g/dL，乳酸2.6 mmol/L，尿量40 mL/hr。患者嗜睡但可唤醒且定向，无再次呕血，可见少量黑便。4小时化验显示肌酐1.5 mg/dL，INR 2.0，血小板68 ×10³/µL，氨78 µmol/L。

content.en: Overnight, the patient becomes confused and somnolent, opens eyes to voice, follows simple commands, believes he is at home, and develops asterixis. Vitals: HR 82, BP 108/66, RR 14, SpO2 97% room air, T 37.9 C. Hgb 7.6 g/dL is stable with no further hematemesis. Labs: creatinine 1.8 mg/dL, urine output 15 mL/hr, ammonia 124 µmol/L, lactate 1.8 mmol/L. Diagnostic paracentesis shows ascitic WBC 620 cells/µL with 78% neutrophils, absolute neutrophil count 484 cells/µL, and SAAG 1.3 g/dL. Orders include lactulose every 2 hours titrated to 3-4 bowel movements/day, rifaximin every 12 hours, holding diuretics, and urgent SBP evaluation/treatment reassessment.
content.zh: 夜间患者出现意识混乱和嗜睡，对声音睁眼，可执行简单指令，但认为自己在家，并出现扑翼样震颤。生命体征：HR 82，BP 108/66，RR 14，室内空气SpO2 97%，T 37.9 C。Hgb 7.6 g/dL稳定，无再次呕血。化验：肌酐1.8 mg/dL，尿量15 mL/hr，氨124 µmol/L，乳酸1.8 mmol/L。诊断性腹腔穿刺显示腹水WBC 620 cells/µL，其中78%为中性粒细胞，绝对中性粒细胞计数484 cells/µL，SAAG 1.3 g/dL。医嘱包括乳果糖每2小时一次并滴定至每日3-4次排便、利福昔明每12小时一次、暂停利尿剂，以及紧急评估/重新评估SBP治疗。

stem.en: Highlight the findings that support the pattern of acute variceal hemorrhage in a decompensated cirrhotic patient.
stem.zh: 请标出支持失代偿性肝硬化患者发生急性静脉曲张出血这一临床模式的发现。

segments.en: Large-volume bright red hematemesis about 45 minutes before arrival.
segments.zh: 到院前约45分钟出现大量鲜红色呕血。

segments.en: Second smaller episode of hematemesis occurred during transport.
segments.zh: 来院途中再次出现少量呕血。

segments.en: HR 118 beats/min.
segments.zh: 心率118次/分。

segments.en: BP 88/54 mmHg.
segments.zh: 血压88/54 mmHg。

segments.en: Pale, diaphoretic appearance with capillary refill of 3 seconds.
segments.zh: 面色苍白、出汗，毛细血管再充盈时间3秒。

segments.en: SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula.
segments.zh: 鼻导管2 L/min吸氧下SpO2为96%。

segments.en: Clear breath sounds bilaterally.
segments.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰。

segments.en: Moderate-to-large ascites with fluid wave and shifting dullness.
segments.zh: 中到大量腹水，有液波震颤和移动性浊音。

segments.en: Caput medusae on the anterior abdominal wall.
segments.zh: 腹前壁可见海蛇头样静脉曲张。

segments.en: Spider angiomata on the upper chest.
segments.zh: 上胸部可见蜘蛛痣。

segments.en: Scleral icterus.
segments.zh: 巩膜黄染。

segments.en: No asterixis and coherent speech.
segments.zh: 无扑翼样震颤，讲话连贯。

segments.en: INR 1.9.
segments.zh: INR 1.9。

segments.en: Platelets 72 ×10³/µL.
segments.zh: 血小板72 ×10³/µL。

segments.en: Albumin 2.4 g/dL.
segments.zh: 白蛋白2.4 g/dL。

segments.en: Glucose 102 mg/dL.
segments.zh: 血糖102 mg/dL。

correct.en: The emergency pattern is massive hematemesis with shock physiology, plus clear evidence of portal hypertension and impaired hepatic synthetic function. Normal oxygenation, clear lungs, normal glucose, and absence of asterixis are useful baselines but do not explain the acute hemorrhage.
correct.zh: 本题的紧急模式是大量呕血伴休克生理表现，同时存在门静脉高压和肝脏合成功能受损的证据。氧合尚可、双肺清晰、血糖正常以及暂时无扑翼样震颤有助于建立基线，但不能解释当前急性出血。

byChoice.en: Large-volume bright red hematemesis about 45 minutes before arrival. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 到院前约45分钟出现大量鲜红色呕血。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Second smaller episode of hematemesis occurred during transport. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 来院途中再次出现少量呕血。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: HR 118 beats/min. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 心率118次/分。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: BP 88/54 mmHg. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 血压88/54 mmHg。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Pale, diaphoretic appearance with capillary refill of 3 seconds. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 面色苍白、出汗，毛细血管再充盈时间3秒。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: SpO2 96% on 2 L nasal cannula. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 鼻导管2 L/min吸氧下SpO2为96%。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

byChoice.en: Clear breath sounds bilaterally. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

byChoice.en: Moderate-to-large ascites with fluid wave and shifting dullness. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 中到大量腹水，有液波震颤和移动性浊音。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Caput medusae on the anterior abdominal wall. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 腹前壁可见海蛇头样静脉曲张。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Spider angiomata on the upper chest. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 上胸部可见蜘蛛痣。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Scleral icterus. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 巩膜黄染。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: No asterixis and coherent speech. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 无扑翼样震颤，讲话连贯。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

byChoice.en: INR 1.9. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: INR 1.9。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Platelets 72 ×10³/µL. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 血小板72 ×10³/µL。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Albumin 2.4 g/dL. This is part of the variceal-bleed pattern.
byChoice.zh: 白蛋白2.4 g/dL。 这是静脉曲张出血模式的一部分。

byChoice.en: Glucose 102 mg/dL. This is not a defining cue for the acute hemorrhagic pattern in this case.
byChoice.zh: 血糖102 mg/dL。 这不是本病例急性出血模式的决定性线索。

testTakingStrategy.en: Cluster cues instead of reacting to one lab. In cirrhosis, hematemesis plus portal-hypertension stigmata and poor hemostatic reserve points to variceal hemorrhage.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 要把线索组合起来看，不要只盯着单个化验值。肝硬化患者出现呕血，再加门静脉高压体征和止血储备差，应优先想到静脉曲张出血。

glossary.defZh: 门静脉高压导致食管或胃静脉曲张破裂出血。
门静脉系统压力升高，可导致腹水、食管静脉曲张和腹壁静脉曲张。
腹壁浅静脉扩张，是门静脉高压的体征之一。
肝脏合成凝血因子和白蛋白的能力下降，可表现为INR升高和低白蛋白。

stem.en: Complete the clinical judgment statement about the Stage 1 trend.
stem.zh: 请补全关于第1阶段病情趋势的临床判断。

clozeStem.en: The Stage 1 findings indicate {{1}} because the patient has {{2}} and {{3}} despite initial crystalloid resuscitation.
clozeStem.zh: 第1阶段的发现提示 {{1}}，因为患者在初步晶体液复苏后仍有 {{2}} 和 {{3}}。

options.en: expected anxiety after seeing blood
options.zh: 看到出血后的预期焦虑反应

options.en: ongoing hemorrhagic shock with inadequate tissue perfusion
options.zh: 持续性失血性休克并组织灌注不足

options.en: stable recovery after the fluid bolus
options.zh: 补液后已稳定恢复

options.en: a lactate rise from 3.4 to 4.1 mmol/L
options.zh: 乳酸从3.4升至4.1 mmol/L

options.en: a normal glucose of 102 mg/dL
options.zh: 血糖102 mg/dL正常

options.en: clear bilateral breath sounds
options.zh: 双肺呼吸音清晰

options.en: only 25 mL urine output in the first hour
options.zh: 第1小时尿量仅25 mL

options.en: hemoglobin now above the target range
options.zh: 血红蛋白已高于目标范围

options.en: oxygen saturation of 97% on nasal cannula
options.zh: 鼻导管吸氧下SpO2为97%

correct.en: The marginal BP response, persistent tachycardia, repeat hematemesis, rising lactate, and oliguria show that perfusion remains inadequate. A hemoglobin of 7.2 g/dL in this context supports single-unit PRBC transfusion to the stated restrictive target, not liberal transfusion.
correct.zh: 血压仅轻微改善、心动过速持续、再次呕血、乳酸升高以及少尿，说明灌注仍不足。在这种情况下血红蛋白7.2 g/dL支持按限制性目标输注1单位红细胞，而不是宽松输血。

byChoice.en: Ongoing hemorrhagic shock is correct because perfusion markers are worsening despite the initial bolus. Anxiety or stable recovery would not explain rising lactate and oliguria.
byChoice.zh: 持续性失血性休克正确，因为初步补液后灌注指标仍在恶化。单纯焦虑或稳定恢复不能解释乳酸升高和少尿。

byChoice.en: The rising lactate is the key perfusion cue. Normal glucose and clear lungs are useful but do not show worsening tissue oxygen debt.
byChoice.zh: 乳酸升高是关键的灌注线索。血糖正常和双肺清晰有参考价值，但不能说明组织缺氧债加重。

byChoice.en: Urine output of 25 mL in the first hour indicates renal hypoperfusion. Oxygenation is not the failing parameter, and the hemoglobin is near the restrictive transfusion threshold rather than above target.
byChoice.zh: 第1小时尿量25 mL提示肾灌注不足。氧合不是当前失败的指标；血红蛋白接近限制性输血阈值，而不是高于目标范围。

testTakingStrategy.en: For shock questions, trend perfusion markers together: mental status, urine output, lactate, HR/BP response, and ongoing losses.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 休克题要把灌注指标放在一起看：意识状态、尿量、乳酸、心率/血压反应以及是否仍在丢失血容量。

glossary.defZh: 组织缺氧或灌注不足时可升高的代谢指标。
尿量减少，常提示肾灌注不足或肾功能受损。
只在较低血红蛋白阈值或有临床需要时输血，以避免过度容量负荷。

stem.en: Which bleeding source should guide the nurse's priority hypothesis and anticipated plan of care before endoscopic confirmation?
stem.zh: 在内镜确认前，护士应以哪一种出血来源作为优先假设并据此预期护理计划？

options.en: Mallory-Weiss tear from forceful retching
options.zh: 剧烈干呕导致的贲门黏膜撕裂

options.en: Lower gastrointestinal bleeding from hemorrhoids
options.zh: 痔疮导致的下消化道出血

options.en: Esophageal variceal hemorrhage related to portal hypertension
options.zh: 门静脉高压相关的食管静脉曲张出血

options.en: Peptic ulcer bleeding from NSAID use
options.zh: NSAID使用导致的消化性溃疡出血

correct.en: Known cirrhosis, portal hypertension, documented esophageal varices, large-volume hematemesis, ascites, caput medusae, and coagulopathy all point to variceal hemorrhage. The nurse should anticipate variceal-specific therapy while endoscopy is being arranged.
correct.zh: 已知肝硬化、门静脉高压、既往食管静脉曲张、大量呕血、腹水、海蛇头样静脉曲张和凝血异常共同指向静脉曲张出血。安排内镜的同时，护士应预期静脉曲张出血的特异性治疗。

byChoice.en: Hemorrhoids cause lower GI bleeding, not large-volume bright red hematemesis.
byChoice.zh: 痔疮导致下消化道出血，不会造成大量鲜红色呕血。

byChoice.en: Peptic ulcer disease remains possible in upper GI bleeding, but this patient denies NSAID use and has a stronger variceal risk pattern.
byChoice.zh: 上消化道出血仍可能来自消化性溃疡，但患者否认NSAID使用，且静脉曲张风险模式更强。

byChoice.en: This is the best hypothesis because the patient has known portal hypertension and prior esophageal varices with massive hematemesis.
byChoice.zh: 这是最佳假设，因为患者有已知门静脉高压和既往食管静脉曲张，并出现大量呕血。

byChoice.en: A Mallory-Weiss tear usually follows forceful retching and is not the priority hypothesis when known varices and portal hypertension are present.
byChoice.zh: 贲门黏膜撕裂通常发生在剧烈干呕后；在已知静脉曲张和门静脉高压存在时，不是优先假设。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use the history that changes management. Prior varices plus cirrhosis turns hematemesis into a presumed variceal bleed until proven otherwise.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 抓住会改变处理方向的病史。既往静脉曲张加肝硬化，使呕血在证实前应按疑似静脉曲张出血处理。

glossary.defZh: 门静脉高压导致食管静脉扩张，破裂时可发生危及生命的呕血。
胃或十二指肠黏膜破损，可导致上消化道出血。
呕吐或干呕后胃食管交界处黏膜撕裂导致出血。

stem.en: The provider orders 1 unit PRBC with a target hemoglobin of 7-8 g/dL. Which concurrent interventions should the nurse implement or anticipate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 医嘱输注1单位浓缩红细胞，目标血红蛋白7-8 g/dL。护士应执行或预期哪些同步干预？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Maintain NPO status and prepare for emergent EGD with band ligation.
options.zh: 维持禁食，准备急诊胃镜及套扎止血。

options.en: Transfuse additional PRBCs until hemoglobin reaches 10 g/dL.
options.zh: 继续输注红细胞直到血红蛋白达到10 g/dL。

options.en: Administer ceftriaxone prophylaxis as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱给予头孢曲松预防性抗感染。

options.en: Position with head of bed elevated and maintain airway readiness.
options.zh: 抬高床头并保持气道准备。

options.en: Give fresh frozen plasma solely to normalize the INR before endoscopy.
options.zh: 仅为在内镜前纠正INR而输注新鲜冰冻血浆。

options.en: Continue the octreotide infusion as ordered.
options.zh: 按医嘱继续奥曲肽静脉泵入。

correct.en: Octreotide, ceftriaxone, endoscopy readiness, NPO status, and airway protection are concurrent priorities in suspected variceal hemorrhage. The case protocol sets a restrictive PRBC target; routine liberal transfusion or large-volume plasma just to normalize cirrhosis-related INR can worsen volume/portal-pressure problems and delay definitive hemostasis.
correct.zh: 疑似静脉曲张出血时，奥曲肽、头孢曲松、内镜准备、禁食和气道保护是同步优先事项。本病例方案设定限制性红细胞输血目标；常规宽松输血或仅为纠正肝硬化相关INR而大量输注血浆，可能加重容量/门静脉压力问题并延误最终止血。

byChoice.en: Ceftriaxone is ordered for infection/SBP prophylaxis in a cirrhotic patient with GI hemorrhage.
byChoice.zh: 肝硬化合并消化道出血时，头孢曲松用于感染/SBP预防。

byChoice.en: A hemoglobin target of 10 g/dL is too liberal for this protocol and may increase portal pressure and rebleeding risk.
byChoice.zh: 把血红蛋白目标定到10 g/dL对本方案过于宽松，可能升高门静脉压力并增加再出血风险。

byChoice.en: Active hematemesis creates aspiration risk; positioning and airway readiness are nursing priorities.
byChoice.zh: 活动性呕血有误吸风险；体位和气道准备是护理优先事项。

byChoice.en: Octreotide reduces splanchnic blood flow and is used as a bridge to and after endoscopic therapy.
byChoice.zh: 奥曲肽可减少内脏血流，是内镜治疗前后用于降低静脉曲张出血风险的药物。

byChoice.en: Endoscopic band ligation is the definitive hemostatic intervention for active esophageal variceal bleeding, so NPO and preparation are appropriate.
byChoice.zh: 内镜套扎是活动性食管静脉曲张出血的关键止血措施，因此禁食和准备内镜是正确的。

byChoice.en: Chronic cirrhosis-related INR elevation is not an automatic reason to delay endoscopy for plasma correction; plasma adds volume and can worsen portal-pressure physiology.
byChoice.zh: 慢性肝硬化导致的INR升高并不自动要求为输血浆而推迟内镜；血浆会增加容量，可能加重门静脉压力问题。

testTakingStrategy.en: When several actions are ordered for an unstable bleed, separate concurrent stabilizing actions from harmful attempts to normalize every lab value.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不稳定出血题中有多项医嘱时，要区分同步稳定病情的措施和“纠正每个异常化验值”的有害做法。

glossary.defZh: 可降低内脏血流和门静脉压力的药物，常用于静脉曲张出血。
用橡皮圈结扎出血静脉曲张以达到止血。
含凝血因子的血液制品；不应仅因肝硬化INR升高而常规用于内镜前纠正。

stem.en: For each immediate post-banding nursing action or interpretation, indicate whether it is appropriate now.
stem.zh: 对于内镜套扎后的每项护理行动或判断，请判断当前是否适当。

rows.en: Continue the octreotide infusion per protocol.
rows.zh: 按方案继续奥曲肽泵入。

rows.en: Monitor for true rebleeding: new hematemesis, hemodynamic decline, or falling serial hemoglobin.
rows.zh: 监测真正再出血迹象：再次呕血、血流动力学恶化或连续血红蛋白下降。

rows.en: Treat the small amount of melena alone as proof of active rebleeding.
rows.zh: 仅凭少量黑便就认定为活动性再出血。

rows.en: Stop ceftriaxone because endoscopic hemostasis was achieved.
rows.zh: 因内镜止血成功而停止头孢曲松。

rows.en: Monitor mental status, ammonia trend, urine output, and creatinine.
rows.zh: 监测意识状态、氨水平趋势、尿量和肌酐。

rows.en: Transfuse more PRBCs now because hemoglobin is 7.8 g/dL.
rows.zh: 因血红蛋白7.8 g/dL立即继续输注红细胞。

correct.en: After banding, the hemorrhage markers are improving, but early rebleeding, infection, hepatic encephalopathy, and renal injury remain major risks. Melena alone can reflect digested earlier blood when hemoglobin and hemodynamics are stable.
correct.zh: 套扎后出血指标改善，但早期再出血、感染、肝性脑病和肾损伤仍是主要风险。在血红蛋白和血流动力学稳定时，单独黑便可来自先前出血的消化血液。

byChoice.en: Continuing octreotide is appropriate because vasoactive therapy is commonly continued after hemostasis to reduce early rebleeding risk.
byChoice.zh: 继续奥曲肽适当，因为止血后通常继续血管活性治疗以降低早期再出血风险。

byChoice.en: These are the correct indicators of recurrent bleeding and should be monitored closely.
byChoice.zh: 这些是真正再出血的正确指标，应密切监测。

byChoice.en: Melena alone is not proof of new bleeding when it follows large hematemesis and the hemoglobin and vital signs are stable.
byChoice.zh: 大量呕血后出现黑便，若血红蛋白和生命体征稳定，单独黑便不能证明新出血。

byChoice.en: Antibiotic prophylaxis is not stopped simply because banding controlled the bleeding.
byChoice.zh: 不能仅因套扎控制出血就停止预防性抗生素。

byChoice.en: Rising ammonia and creatinine after the bleed make encephalopathy and renal injury important surveillance targets.
byChoice.zh: 出血后氨和肌酐升高，使肝性脑病和肾损伤成为重要监测目标。

byChoice.en: Hemoglobin 7.8 g/dL is within the stated restrictive target, so more PRBCs are not indicated based on this value alone.
byChoice.zh: 血红蛋白7.8 g/dL在本方案限制性目标范围内，不能仅凭此数值继续输血。

testTakingStrategy.en: After an intervention, evaluate trajectory: what improved, what remains risky, and what finding is expected from earlier events.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 干预后要评估趋势：哪些改善了、哪些仍有风险、哪些发现可由先前事件解释。

glossary.defZh: 已控制的出血再次发生，可表现为新呕血、血压下降、心率上升或血红蛋白下降。
消化后的血液使粪便呈黑色柏油样，可来自先前上消化道出血。
晚期肝病中有效循环血量下降和肾血流改变导致肾功能恶化的过程。

stem.en: At Stage 3, which conclusions or nursing actions are supported by the current data? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 第3阶段，根据当前资料支持哪些结论或护理行动？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Notify the provider that ascitic PMN count meets the SBP diagnostic threshold and anticipate antibiotic reassessment.
options.zh: 通知医护团队腹水PMN计数达到SBP诊断阈值，并预期重新评估抗生素方案。

options.en: Recognize hepatic encephalopathy and administer lactulose/rifaximin as ordered.
options.zh: 识别肝性脑病，并按医嘱给予乳果糖/利福昔明。

options.en: Continue serial neurological assessments, including orientation, level of consciousness, and asterixis.
options.zh: 继续连续神经系统评估，包括定向力、意识水平和扑翼样震颤。

options.en: Attribute the confusion to residual procedural sedation and defer lactulose until the next routine assessment.
options.zh: 将意识混乱归因于操作后残余镇静，推迟乳果糖至下一次常规评估。

options.en: Closely monitor urine output and creatinine because SBP with AKI raises concern for hepatorenal syndrome.
options.zh: 密切监测尿量和肌酐，因为SBP合并AKI提示肝肾综合征风险。

options.en: Give additional PRBCs to raise hemoglobin above 8 g/dL because the patient looks worse.
options.zh: 因患者看起来更差而追加输注红细胞，使血红蛋白超过8 g/dL。

correct.en: The hemorrhage appears controlled, but the patient has new hepatic encephalopathy, SBP by ascitic PMN count, and worsening renal function. The nursing priority shifts to treating encephalopathy, communicating SBP results, and tracking neurologic and renal trajectories.
correct.zh: 出血似乎已控制，但患者出现新的肝性脑病、腹水PMN计数符合SBP，以及肾功能恶化。护理重点转向治疗脑病、报告SBP结果，并追踪神经和肾功能趋势。

byChoice.en: Confusion, somnolence, asterixis, and ammonia 124 µmol/L support hepatic encephalopathy; lactulose and rifaximin are the ordered therapies.
byChoice.zh: 意识混乱、嗜睡、扑翼样震颤和氨124 µmol/L支持肝性脑病；乳果糖和利福昔明是医嘱治疗。

byChoice.en: Serial neurological assessment shows whether encephalopathy is improving or progressing despite therapy.
byChoice.zh: 连续神经系统评估可判断脑病在治疗后是改善还是进展。

byChoice.en: The stable hemoglobin of 7.6 g/dL and absence of new hematemesis argue against rebleeding; transfusion above target would not treat the current problem.
byChoice.zh: 血红蛋白7.6 g/dL稳定且无再次呕血，不支持再出血；超目标输血不能治疗当前问题。

byChoice.en: Creatinine is rising and urine output is falling in the setting of SBP, which raises concern for hepatorenal syndrome physiology.
byChoice.zh: 在SBP背景下肌酐上升且尿量下降，提示肝肾综合征相关风险。

byChoice.en: The decline occurs more than 12 hours after sedation, after the patient had been oriented, and includes new asterixis and marked hyperammonemia; deferring treatment is unsafe.
byChoice.zh: 意识下降发生在镇静12小时以上之后，且患者曾清醒定向，同时出现新的扑翼样震颤和明显高氨血症；推迟治疗不安全。

byChoice.en: Ascitic PMN 484 cells/µL exceeds the case threshold of 250 cells/µL, so SBP must be communicated and treatment reassessed.
byChoice.zh: 腹水PMN 484 cells/µL超过本病例250 cells/µL阈值，必须报告SBP并重新评估治疗。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a patient worsens after the initial emergency is controlled, ask whether the new data show a complication rather than failure of the first treatment.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 初始急症控制后患者恶化时，要判断新资料是否提示并发症，而不是简单认为第一次治疗失败。

glossary.defZh: 肝功能衰竭或门体分流导致毒素积聚，引起意识和神经功能改变。
无明确腹腔感染源的腹水感染，肝硬化腹水患者风险较高。
手腕伸展时出现的不规则扑翼样抖动，常见于肝性脑病。
晚期肝病和门静脉高压背景下发生的功能性肾衰竭。

correct.en: This case moves from recognition of presumed variceal hemorrhage, through shock-pattern analysis and variceal-specific stabilization, to post-banding surveillance and recognition of downstream complications. The correct judgment arc is to treat massive hematemesis in a cirrhotic patient with portal hypertension as variceal bleeding; support perfusion without over-transfusing; continue vasoactive therapy and antibiotic prophylaxis; prepare for definitive endoscopic banding; then monitor for rebleeding, hepatic encephalopathy, SBP, and renal deterioration. By Stage 3, stable hemoglobin and normalized lactate argue against recurrent hemorrhagic shock, while confusion with asterixis, ammonia 124 µmol/L, ascitic PMN 484 cells/µL, rising creatinine, and oliguria identify hepatic encephalopathy, SBP, and possible hepatorenal physiology as the new priorities.
correct.zh: 本病例的临床判断路径从识别疑似静脉曲张出血开始，经过休克模式分析和静脉曲张出血的特异性稳定措施，再进入套扎后监测和下游并发症识别。正确思路是：肝硬化合并门静脉高压患者出现大量呕血时，先按静脉曲张出血处理；支持灌注但避免过度输血；继续血管活性药物和预防性抗生素；准备内镜套扎这一关键止血措施；随后监测再出血、肝性脑病、SBP和肾功能恶化。到第3阶段，血红蛋白稳定和乳酸恢复不支持复发性失血性休克；而意识混乱伴扑翼样震颤、氨124 µmol/L、腹水PMN 484 cells/µL、肌酐升高和少尿，则提示肝性脑病、SBP以及可能的肝肾综合征相关生理成为新优先事项。

testTakingStrategy.en: For unfolding cases, do not anchor on the first emergency after it has improved. Re-rank priorities whenever new trend data appear.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 做展开式病例时，不要在初始急症改善后仍锚定在最初问题上。每当出现新的趋势资料，都要重新排序优先事项。

glossary.defZh: 门静脉高压导致曲张静脉破裂，引起大量上消化道出血。
以较低血红蛋白目标进行输血，避免过度容量负荷和相关风险。
用套扎环机械性闭合出血食管静脉曲张。
肝硬化腹水中无明确腹腔来源的感染，腹水中性粒细胞升高是关键诊断线索。
肝病导致氨等毒素清除不足，引起认知、意识和神经肌肉改变。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 请查看患者病历，并回答本病例题组。

title.en: Postpartum hemorrhage from uterine atony in a grand multiparous client with pregnancy-induced hypertension
title.zh: 妊娠期高血压经产妇因子宫收缩乏力发生的产后出血

summary.en: A 32-year-old G5P5 client is one hour postpartum after a vaginal birth of a 4.2 kg infant. She has pregnancy-induced hypertension treated with labetalol and mild intermittent asthma. She develops heavy bleeding, a boggy displaced fundus, tachycardia, and hypotension relative to her hypertensive baseline.
summary.zh: 一名 32 岁 G5P5 产妇在阴道分娩 4.2 kg 新生儿后 1 小时处于产后恢复期。她有妊娠期高血压，使用拉贝洛尔治疗，并有轻度间歇性哮喘。她出现大量出血、子宫底偏移且松软、心动过速，以及相对高血压基线明显下降的血压。

content.en: G5P5, one hour postpartum after vaginal birth of a 4.2 kg infant. Second stage lasted 3 hours; oxytocin augmentation was used during first stage. Placenta delivered intact and appeared complete. Pregnancy-induced hypertension was diagnosed at 34 weeks and treated with labetalol 200 mg twice daily. History includes mild intermittent asthma. No bleeding disorder, prior PPH, or uterine surgery. Admission BP 148/94 mmHg. Admission Hgb 11.8 g/dL, Hct 35.2%. Blood type O-positive; type and screen sent on admission. Oxytocin 20 units in 1 L LR has been infusing for about 50 minutes after placental delivery.
content.zh: G5P5，阴道分娩 4.2 kg 新生儿后 1 小时。第二产程持续 3 小时；第一产程使用催产素加强宫缩。胎盘娩出完整，检查外观完整。34 周诊断妊娠期高血压，使用拉贝洛尔 200 mg 每日两次。既往有轻度间歇性哮喘。无出血性疾病、既往产后出血或子宫手术史。入院血压 148/94 mmHg。入院 Hgb 11.8 g/dL，Hct 35.2%。血型 O 阳性；入院已送血型筛查。胎盘娩出后已按医嘱输注催产素 20 units 加入 1 L LR，约 50 分钟。

content.en: Client says she feels 'dizzy and wet.' She is pale, diaphoretic, alert, oriented, and anxious. Underpads show a large amount of blood; the perineal pad placed 20 minutes ago is saturated. Vital signs: T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C), HR 118, BP 90/62 mmHg, RR 22, SpO2 97% on room air. Uterus is two fingerbreadths above the umbilicus, deviated to the right, and boggy; it does not stay firm after massage. Lochia is heavy with dark-red flow and several small clots. Repaired second-degree perineal laceration has no active bleeding and no visible hematoma. Bladder is palpable above the symphysis pubis. Skin is cool and clammy; capillary refill 3 seconds. Estimated blood loss is 600 mL and visibly increasing.
content.zh: 患者说自己“头晕，而且感觉很湿”。她面色苍白、出汗，意识清醒、定向力正常但焦虑。护理垫上有大量血液；20 分钟前更换的会阴垫已饱和。生命体征：T 98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，HR 118，BP 90/62 mmHg，RR 22，室内空气 SpO2 97%。子宫底位于脐上两横指，向右偏移且松软；按摩后不能维持坚硬。恶露量多，暗红色流出并有数个小血块。已缝合的二度会阴裂伤无活动性出血，也未见血肿。耻骨联合上方可触及膀胱。皮肤湿冷；毛细血管再充盈 3 秒。估计失血量 600 mL，并且肉眼可见仍在增加。

content.en: Hgb 11.8 g/dL, Hct 35.2%, platelets 188 ×10³/µL, fibrinogen 410 mg/dL, INR 1.0, aPTT 28 sec. Sodium 138 mEq/L, potassium 3.9 mEq/L, creatinine 0.7 mg/dL, glucose 92 mg/dL. Urinalysis: 1+ protein, otherwise unremarkable.
content.zh: Hgb 11.8 g/dL，Hct 35.2%，血小板 188 ×10³/µL，纤维蛋白原 410 mg/dL，INR 1.0，aPTT 28 秒。钠 138 mEq/L，钾 3.9 mEq/L，肌酐 0.7 mg/dL，血糖 92 mg/dL。尿检：蛋白 1+，其余无明显异常。

title.zh: 第 1 阶段：初始出血处理
第 1 阶段：初始出血处理

content.en: The nurse begins external fundal massage with lower uterine support and calls for assistance. Straight catheterization drains 450 mL of clear urine; the uterus descends to the umbilicus but remains boggy. Oxytocin is confirmed infusing and increased per standing order to infuse the remaining volume over 30 minutes. Two 16-gauge peripheral IVs are placed; warmed LR is hung wide open. Quantitative blood loss is now 800 mL. Vital signs: HR 124, BP 86/58, RR 24, SpO2 96% on room air. The provider is called to bedside.
content.zh: 护士开始在下方支托子宫的同时进行外部子宫底按摩，并呼叫协助。一次性导尿排出清亮尿液 450 mL；子宫下降至脐水平但仍松软。确认催产素正在输注，并按常规医嘱提高速度，在 30 分钟内输完剩余液体。置入两条 16G 外周静脉通路；温热 LR 全速开放。定量失血现为 800 mL。生命体征：HR 124，BP 86/58，RR 24，室内空气 SpO2 96%。已呼叫医师到床旁。

title.en: Stage 2: Persistent atony and medication selection
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：子宫收缩乏力持续及药物选择

title.en: Stage 2: Persistent atony and medication selection
title.zh: 第 2 阶段：子宫收缩乏力持续及药物选择

content.en: Despite massage and increased oxytocin, the uterus intermittently firms then relaxes within seconds. QBL is 1,200 mL. Vital signs: HR 132, BP 80/52, RR 26, SpO2 95% on room air. The client is confused and markedly pale with capillary refill 4 seconds. The provider rules out retained placental fragments and unrepaired cervical/vaginal lacerations.
